dpa.engine;\n\nimport dpa.decimal.Decimal;\nimport dpa.decimal.RoundingMode;\nimport dpa.error.DecimalOverflowException;\nimport dpa.error.QueryException;\n\nimport java.math.BigInteger;\n\n/**\n * Runtime evaluation of compiled {@link Expr} nodes.\n *\n * <p>All methods are intentionally static and take the active {@link Settings}:\n * evaluation is stateless. {@code null} propagates through arithmetic and\n * comparisons; logical operators implement SQL-style three-valued logic.\n */\nfinal class Evaluators {\n\n    private Evaluators() {\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Unary\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    static Object evalUnary(Expr.UnaryExpr u, EvalCtx ctx) {\n        Object v = u.operand().eval(ctx);\n        switch (u.op()) {\n            case \"-\": {\n                if (v == null) {\n                    return null;\n                }\n                if (v instanceof Decimal d) {\n                    return d.negate();\n                }\n                if (v instanceof Long l) {\n                    if (l == Long.MIN_VALUE) {\n                        throw new DecimalOverflowException(\"bigint negation overflow: \" + l);\n                    }\n                    return -l;\n                }\n                throw typeError(\"unary negation\", v);\n            }\n            case \"+\":\n                return v;\n            case \"not\": {\n                Boolean b = asBool(v);\n                return b == null ? null : !b;\n            }\n            case \"isnull\":\n                return v == null;\n            case \"isnotnull\":\n                return v != null;\n            default:\n                throw new QueryException(\"unknown unary operator: \" + u.op());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Binary\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    static Object evalBinary(Expr.BinaryExpr b, EvalCtx ctx) {\n        String op = b.op();\n\n        if (\"and\".equals(op) || \"or\".equals(op)) {\n            Boolean l = asBool(b.left().eval(ctx));\n            Boolean r = asBool(b.right().eval(ctx));\n            if (\"and\".equals(op)) {\n                if (Boolean.FALSE.equals(l) || Boolean.FALSE.equals(r)) {\n                    return Boolean.FALSE;\n                }\n                if (l == null || r == null) {\n                    return null;\n                }\n                return Boolean.TRUE;\n            }\n            if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(l) || Boolean.TRUE.equals(r)) {\n                return Boolean.TRUE;\n            }\n            if (l == null || r == null) {\n                return null;\n            }\n            return Boolean.FALSE;\n        }\n\n        Object rawL = b.left().eval(ctx);\n        Object rawR = b.right().eval(ctx);\n\n        switch (op) {\n            case \"isnull\":\n                return rawL == null;\n            case \"isnotnull\":\n                return rawL != null;\n            default:\n                break;\n        }\n\n        if (rawL == null || rawR == null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        if (isCompare(op)) {\n            return compareValues(rawL, rawR, op);\n        }\n\n        // Arithmetic from here on: both operands numeric.\n        Decimal a = requireDecimal(rawL, op, ctx.settings());\n        Decimal d = requireDecimal(rawR, op, ctx.settings());\n        int maxPrecision = ctx.settings().maxPrecision();\n        RoundingMode mode = ctx.settings().roundingMode();\n\n        switch (op) {\n            case \"+\":\n                return a.add(d, maxPrecision);\n            case \"-\":\n                return a.sub(d, maxPrecision);\n            case \"*\":\n                return a.mul(d, maxPrecision);\n            case \"/\": {\n                int scale = inferDivideScale(b, ctx.settings());\n                return a.divide(d, scale, mode, maxPrecision);\n            }\n            default:\n                throw new QueryException(\"unknown binary operator: \" + op);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static boolean isCompare(String op) {\n        return op.equals(\"=\") || op.equals(\"!=\") || op.equals(\"<>\")\n                || op.equals(\"<\") || op.equals(\"<=\") || op.equals(\">\") || op.equals(\">=\");\n    }\n\n    private static Boolean compareValues(Object rawL, Object rawR, String op) {\n        int cmp;\n        if (rawL instanceof Decimal || rawR instanceof Decimal\n                || rawL instanceof Long || rawR instanceof Long) {\n            // Numeric comparison; Long is promoted to Decimal exactly.\n            Decimal a = decimalOf(rawL);\n            Decimal b = decimalOf(rawR);\n            if (a == null || b == null) {\n                return null; // null compared to a number\n            }\n            cmp = a.compareTo(b);\n        } else if (rawL instanceof Boolean || rawR instanceof Boolean) {\n            if (!(rawL instanceof Boolean) || !(rawR instanceof Boolean)) {\n                throw typeError(\"comparison\", rawL);\n            }\n            cmp = Boolean.compare((Boolean) rawL, (Boolean) rawR);\n        } else {\n            if (!(rawL instanceof String) || !(rawR instanceof String)) {\n                throw typeError(\"comparison\", rawL);\n            }\n            cmp = ((String) rawL).compareTo((String) rawR);\n        }\n        switch (op) {\n            case \"=\":\n                return cmp == 0;\n            case \"!=\":\n            case \"<>\":\n                return cmp != 0;\n            case \"<\":\n                return cmp < 0;\n            case \"<=\":\n                return cmp <= 0;\n            case \">\":\n                return cmp > 0;\n            case \">=\":\n                return cmp >= 0;\n            default:\n                throw new QueryException(\"unknown comparison operator: \" + op);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Cast\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    static Object evalCast(Expr.CastExpr c, EvalCtx ctx) {\n        Object v = c.operand().eval(ctx);\n        if (v == null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        TypeInfo target = c.typeInfo();\n        int maxPrecision = ctx.settings().maxPrecision();\n        switch (target.type()) {\n            case DECIMAL: {\n                Decimal d = requireDecimal(v, \"cast\", ctx.settings());\n                // Rescale first (rounding fractional digits), then enforce precision\n                // on the canonical rounded value so leading digits can never be lost.\n                Decimal scaled = d.setScale(target.scale(), c.mode());\n                if (scaled.precision() > target.precision()) {\n                    throw new DecimalOverflowException(\n                            \"CAST to DECIMAL(\" + target.precision() + \",\" + target.scale()\n                                    + \") overflows for value \" + scaled.toPlainString()\n                                    + \" (precision \" + scaled.precision() + \")\");\n                }\n                if (scaled.precision() > maxPrecision) {\n                    throw new DecimalOverflowException(\n                            \"CAST result precision \" + scaled.precision()\n                                    + \" exceeds max precision \" + maxPrecision);\n                }\n                return scaled;\n            }\n            case BIGINT: {\n                Decimal d = requireDecimal(v, \"cast\", ctx.settings());\n                Decimal rounded = d.setScale(0, c.mode());\n                BigInteger bi = rounded.unscaled();\n                if (bi.compareTo(BigInteger.valueOf(Long.MAX_VALUE)) > 0\n                        || bi.compareTo(BigInteger.valueOf(Long.MIN_VALUE)) < 0) {\n                    throw new DecimalOverflowException(\n                            \"CAST to BIGINT overflows for value \" + rounded.toPlainString());\n                }\n                return bi.longValueExact();\n            }\n            default:\n                throw new QueryException(\"cannot cast to type \" + target.type());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Type/value plumbing\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /** Exact promotion of a runtime value to Decimal. Long becomes Decimal(p,0). */\n    static Decimal decimalOf(Object v) {\n        if (v instanceof Decimal d) {\n            return d;\n        }\n        if (v instanceof Long l) {\n            return Decimal.valueOf(l);\n        }\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    private static Decimal requireDecimal(Object v, String op, Settings settings) {\n        Decimal d = decimalOf(v);\n        if (d != null) {\n            return d;\n        }\n        throw typeError(op, v);\n    }\n\n    private static QueryException typeError(String op, Object v) {\n        return new QueryException(\n                \"type error in \" + op + \": non-numeric value of kind \"\n                        + (v == null ? \"NULL\" : v.getClass().getSimpleName()));\n    }\n\n    private static Boolean asBool(Object v) {\n        if (v == null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        if (v instanceof Boolean b) {\n            return b;\n        }\n        throw new QueryException(\"expected BOOLEAN, got \" + v.getClass().getSimpleName());\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Result scale of a division node: the node's inferred type carries it, but we\n     * keep it derivable from operand types plus settings for plans without a cast.\n     */\n    private static int inferDivideScale(Expr.BinaryExpr b, Settings settings) {\n        TypeInfo t = b.typeInfo();\n        if (t.type() == SqlType.DECIMAL) {\n            return t.scale();\n        }\n        return Math.max(typeScale(b.left().typeInfo()), typeScale(b.right().typeInfo()))\n                + settings.divideExtraScale();\n    }\n\n    private static int typeScale(TypeInfo t) {\n        return t.type() == SqlType.DECIMAL ? t.scale() : 0;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_6170cd6aff34449b441004d8","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":819,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":55096,"output_tokens":2659,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_zz64xi8xpm1owd89bn3goors":{"content":"package final Map<String, TypeInfo> columns = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n\n    private Schema(List<?> columnDefs, Settings settings) {\n        for (Object o : columnDefs) {\n            if (!(o instanceof Map)) {\n                throw new QueryException(\"each columns entry must be an object\");\n            }\n            Map<?, ?> def = (Map<?, ?>) o;\n            Object nameObj = def.get(\"name\");\n            if (!(nameObj instanceof String)) {\n                throw new QueryException(\"column definition needs a string 'name'\");\n            }\n            String name = (String) nameObj;\n            if (columns.containsKey(name)) {\n                throw new QueryException(\"duplicate column name: \" + name);\n            }\n            columns.put(name, parseType(def));\n        }\n        if (columns.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"table must declare at least one column\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static Schema fromJson(List<?> columnDefs, Settings settings) {\n        return new Schema(columnDefs, settings);\n    }\n\n    private static TypeInfo parseType(Map<?, ?> def) {\n        Object typeObj = def.get(\"type\");\n        if (!(typeObj instanceof String)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"column \" + def.get(\"name\") + \" needs a string 'type'\");\n        }\n        String type = ((String) typeObj).trim().toUpperCase();\n        switch (type) {\n            case \"BIGINT\":\n                return TypeInfo.bigint();\n            case \"TEXT\":\n            case \"VARCHAR\":\n                return TypeInfo.text();\n            case \"BOOLEAN\":\n            case \"BOOL\":\n                return TypeInfo.bool();\n            case \"DECIMAL\":\n            case \"NUMERIC\": {\n                int precision = Settings.intFromJson(\n                        orDefault(def.get(\"precision\"), 38), \"column.precision\");\n                int scale = Settings.intFromJson(\n                        orDefault(def.get(\"scale\"), 0), \"column.scale\");\n                if (precision < 1) {\n                    throw new QueryException(\"DECIMAL precision must be >= 1\");\n                }\n                if (scale < 0 || scale > precision) {\n                    throw new QueryException(\n                            \"DECIMAL scale must satisfy 0 <= scale <= precision for column \"\n                                    + def.get(\"name\"));\n                }\n                return TypeInfo.decimal(precision, scale);\n            }\n            default:\n                throw new QueryException(\"unsupported column type: \" + type);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static Object orDefault(Object v, int dflt) {\n        return v == null ? dflt : v;\n    }\n\n    public Map<String, TypeInfo> columns() {\n        return columns;\n    }\n\n    public TypeInfo typeOf(String name) {\n        TypeInfo t = columns.get(name);\n        if (t == null) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"unknown column: \" + name);\n        }\n        return t;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Coerce one JSON-supplied value to the declared runtime type.\n     *\n     * <p>Numbers arriving as JSON text ({@link JsonNumber}) are parsed through\n     * {@link Decimal#parse} only; they never pass through {@code double}.\n     */\n    Object coerce(String column, Object raw, Settings settings) {\n        TypeInfo target = typeOf(column);\n        if (raw == null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        switch (target.type()) {\n            case TEXT:\n                if (raw instanceof String s) {\n                    return s;\n                }\n                throw new QueryException(\"column \" + column + \" expects TEXT, got \" + describe(raw));\n            case BOOLEAN:\n                if (raw instanceof Boolean b) {\n                    return b;\n                }\n                throw new QueryException(\"column \" + column + \" expects BOOLEAN, got \" + describe(raw));\n            case BIGINT: {\n                Decimal d = parseIncomingNumber(column, raw, settings);\n                Decimal rounded = d.setScale(0, settings.roundingMode());\n                if (rounded.precision() > 19 || rounded.unscaled().bitLength() > 63) {\n                    throw new DecimalOverflowException(\n                            \"value \" + rounded.toPlainString() + \" does not fit BIGINT for column \"\n                                    + column);\n                }\n                return rounded.unscaled().longValueExact();\n            }\n            case DECIMAL: {\n                Decimal d = parseIncomingNumber(column, raw, settings);\n                Decimal scaled = d.setScale(target.scale(), settings.roundingMode());\n                if (scaled.precision() > target.precision()) {\n                    throw new DecimalOverflowException(\n                            \"value \" + scaled.toPlainString() + \" exceeds DECIMAL(\"\n                                    + target.precision() + \",\" + target.scale() + \") for column \"\n                                    + column + \" (precision \" + scaled.precision() + \")\");\n                }\n                if (scaled.precision() > settings.maxPrecision()) {\n                    throw new DecimalOverflowException(\n                            \"value \" + scaled.toPlainString() + \" exceeds max precision \"\n                                    + settings.maxPrecision() + \" for column \" + column);\n                }\n                return scaled;\n            }\n            default:\n                throw new QueryException(\"unsupported column type for \" + column);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Decimal parseIncomingNumber(String column, Object raw, Settings settings) {\n        if (raw instanceof Decimal d) {\n            return d;\n        }\n        if (raw instanceof JsonNumber n) {\n            return Decimal.parse(n.raw(), settings.maxPrecision());\n        }\n        if (raw instanceof Long || raw instanceof Integer) {\n            return Decimal.valueOf(((Number) raw).longValue());\n        }\n        if (raw instanceof String s) {\n            // Accept numeric values given as JSON strings too: the canonical way to\n            // pass an exact decimal in environments that might re-parse numbers.\n            return Decimal.parse(s, settings.maxPrecision());\n        }\n        throw new QueryException(\"column \" + column + \" expects a number, got \" + describe(raw));\n    }\n\n    private static String describe(Object v) {\n        if (v instanceof JsonNumber n) {\n            return \"number \" + n.raw();\n        }\n        if (v instanceof String) {\n            return \"string \\\"\" + v + \"\\\"\";\n        }\n        return v.getClass().getSimpleName();\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_8a793878c74acfb5715d6d0d","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":880,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":58168,"output_tokens":1727,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_oid9hjyu8d5q1gbqvr8sy05d":{"content":"package Decimal arithmetic result types follow:\n * <pre>\n *   add/sub : scale = max(s1,s2), precision = max(p1-s1,p2-s2)+scale+1\n *   mul     : scale = s1+s2,       precision = p1+p2\n *   div     : scale = max(s1,s2)+divideExtraScale (or explicit),\n *             precision = p1 + scale   (bounded by maxPrecision)\n * </pre>\n * Precision figures describe the declared type; runtime overflow is still checked\n * against {@code settings.maxPrecision}.\n */\npublic final class QueryCompiler {\n\n    /** A named output projection item. */\n    public record ProjectionItem(String name, Expr expr, boolean generatedName) {\n    }\n\n    /** Compiled query ready for execution. */\n    public record CompiledQuery(\n            Expr filter,\n            List<String> groupBy,\n            List<ProjectionItem> projection,\n            boolean aggregateQuery,\n            List<Expr.AggregateExpr> aggregates,\n            boolean explain) {\n    }\n\n    private final Schema schema;\n    private final Settings settings;\n    private int nextAggregateId;\n\n    public QueryCompiler(Schema schema, Settings settings) {\n        this.schema = schema;\n        this.settings = settings;\n    }\n\n    public CompiledQuery compile(Map<?, ?> queryJson) {\n        if (queryJson == null) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"request requires a 'query' object\");\n        }\n\n        boolean explain = Boolean.TRUE.equals(queryJson.get(\"explain\"));\n\n        Expr filter = null;\n        Object where = queryJson.get(\"where\");\n        if (where != null) {\n            filter = compileExpr(where);\n            requireBool(filter, \"where\");\n        }\n\n        List<String> groupBy = new ArrayList<>();\n        Object gb = queryJson.get(\"groupBy\");\n        if (gb != null) {\n            if (!(gb instanceof List)) {\n                throw new QueryException(\"query.groupBy must be a list\");\n            }\n            for (Object o : (List<?>) gb) {\n                Expr e = compileExpr(o);\n                if (!(e instanceof Expr.ColumnExpr c)) {\n                    throw new QueryException(\"groupBy entries must be plain column references\");\n                }\n                groupBy.add(c.name());\n            }\n        }\n\n        Object selectObj = queryJson.get(\"select\");\n        if (selectObj == null) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"query.select is required\");\n        }\n        if (!(selectObj instanceof List)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"query.select must be a list of named expressions\");\n        }\n\n        // First pass: compile expressions and discover aggregates.\n        List<ProjectionItem> rawProjection = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Object item : (List<?>) selectObj) {\n            rawProjection.add(compileProjectionItem(item));\n        }\n\n        boolean hasAggregate = false;\n        Set<Expr> aggregateSet = new LinkedHashSet<>();\n        for (ProjectionItem p : rawProjection) {\n            Set<Expr> aggs = p.expr().collectAggregates();\n            if (!aggs.isEmpty()) {\n                hasAggregate = true;\n                aggregateSet.addAll(aggs);\n            }\n        }\n        boolean aggregateQuery = hasAggregate || !groupBy.isEmpty();\n\n        // Assign stable accumulator ids (already assigned at construction); keep\n        // ordered list for plan/execution use.\n        List<Expr.AggregateExpr> aggregates = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (aggregateQuery) {\n            validateAggregates(rawProjection, groupBy, aggregateQuery);\n            aggregates.addAll(castAggregates(aggregateSet));\n        }\n\n        return new CompiledQuery(filter, groupBy, rawProjection, aggregateQuery,\n                aggregates, explain);\n    }\n\n    private List<Expr.AggregateExpr> castAggregates(Set<Expr> set) {\n        List<Expr.AggregateExpr> list = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Expr e : set) {\n            list.add((Expr.AggregateExpr) e);\n        }\n        list.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(a.accumulatorId(), b.accumulatorId()));\n        return list;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Aggregate scoping rule:\n     * <ul>\n     *   <li>With GROUP BY, every free column inside an aggregate argument is allowed;\n     *       columns outside aggregates must be grouping keys.</li>\n     *   <li>Without GROUP BY but with an aggregate (global aggregate), every column\n     *       reference must live inside an aggregate.</li>\n     * </ul>\n     */\n    private void validateAggregates(List<ProjectionItem> projection, List<String> groupBy,\n                                    boolean aggregateQuery) {\n        Set<String> groupCols = new HashSet<>(groupBy);\n        for (ProjectionItem p : projection) {\n            validateNode(p.expr(), groupCols, false, p.name());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void validateNode(Expr e, Set<String> groupCols, boolean insideAgg, String itemName) {\n        switch (e) {\n            case Expr.AggregateExpr agg -> {\n                if (agg.arg() != null) {\n                    validateNode(agg.arg(), groupCols, true, itemName);\n                }\n            }\n            case Expr.ColumnExpr c -> {\n                if (!insideAgg && !groupCols.contains(c.name())) {\n                    throw new QueryException(\n                            \"column '\" + c.name() + \"' in select item '\" + itemName\n                                    + \"' must appear in GROUP BY or inside an aggregate function\");\n                }\n            }\n            case Expr.UnaryExpr u -> validateNode(u.operand(), groupCols, insideAgg, itemName);\n            case Expr.BinaryExpr b -> {\n                validateNode(b.left(), groupCols, insideAgg, itemName);\n                validateNode(b.right(), groupCols, insideAgg, itemName);\n            }\n            case Expr.CastExpr c -> validateNode(c.operand(), groupCols, insideAgg, itemName);\n            case Expr.LiteralExpr l -> {\n                // constants always legal\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private ProjectionItem compileProjectionItem(Object item) {\n        if (item instanceof String s) {\n            Expr e = compileExpr(s);\n            if (!(e instanceof Expr.ColumnExpr)) {\n                throw new QueryException(\n                        \"bare select string must be a column reference; use an object for expressions\");\n            }\n            return new ProjectionItem(((Expr.ColumnExpr) e).name(), e, true);\n        }\n        if (!(item instanceof Map)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"each select entry must be 'columnName' or {name, expr}\");\n        }\n        Map<?, ?> m = (Map<?, ?>) item;\n        Object exprObj = m.get(\"expr\");\n        if (exprObj == null) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"select entry requires an 'expr'\");\n        }\n        Expr e = compileExpr(exprObj);\n        Object nameObj = m.get(\"name\");\n        if (nameObj != null) {\n            return new ProjectionItem(String.valueOf(nameObj), e, false);\n        }\n        return new ProjectionItem(suggestName(exprObj, e), e, true);\n    }\n\n    private String suggestName(Object rawExpr, Expr e) {\n        if (rawExpr instanceof String s) {\n            return s;\n        }\n        if (e instanceof Expr.AggregateExpr agg) {\n            String base = agg.function() + (agg.arg() == null ? \"(*)\" : \"\");\n            return base.toLowerCase();\n        }\n        if (e instanceof Expr.ColumnExpr c) {\n            return c.name();\n        }\n        return \"expr\";\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Expression compilation\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    public Expr compileExpr(Object o) {\n        if (o == null) {\n            return new Expr.LiteralExpr(null, TypeInfo.nullType());\n        }\n        if (o instanceof JsonNumber n) {\n            return numericLiteral(n);\n        }\n        if (o instanceof Boolean b) {\n            return new Expr.LiteralExpr(b, TypeInfo.bool());\n        }\n        if (o instanceof String s) {\n            // Bare string: column reference. String literals use {\"lit\": \"...\"}.\n            if (!schema.columns().containsKey(s)) {\n                throw new QueryException(\"unknown column '\" + s\n                        + \"' (string literals must use {\\\"lit\\\": \\\"...\\\"})\");\n            }\n            return new Expr.ColumnExpr(s, schema.typeOf(s));\n        }\n        if (!(o instanceof Map)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"unsupported expression form: \" + o.getClass().getSimpleName());\n        }\n        Map<?, ?> m = (Map<?, ?>) o;\n\n        if (m.containsKey(\"lit\")) {\n            return literalExpr(m.get(\"lit\"));\n        }\n        if (m.containsKey(\"col\")) {\n            String name = String.valueOf(m.get(\"col\"));\n            return new Expr.ColumnExpr(name, schema.typeOf(name));\n        }\n        if (m.containsKey(\"op\")) {\n            return opExpr(m);\n        }\n        if (m.containsKey(\"func\")) {\n            return funcExpr(m);\n        }\n        throw new QueryException(\n                \"expression object must contain one of 'lit','col','op','func'; got keys \" + m.keySet());\n    }\n\n    private Expr.LiteralExpr literalExpr(Object raw) {\n        if (raw == null) {\n            return new Expr.LiteralExpr(null, TypeInfo.nullType());\n        }\n        if (raw instanceof Boolean b) {\n            return new Expr.LiteralExpr(b, TypeInfo.bool());\n        }\n        if (raw instanceof String s) {\n            return new Expr.LiteralExpr(s, TypeInfo.text());\n        }\n        if (raw instanceof JsonNumber n) {\n            return numericLiteral(n);\n        }\n        throw new QueryException(\"unsupported literal kind: \" + raw.getClass().getSimpleName());\n    }\n\n    private Expr.LiteralExpr numericLiteral(JsonNumber n) {\n        Decimal d = Decimal.parse(n.raw(), settings.maxPrecision());\n        int p = d.precision();\n        int s = d.scale();\n        return new Expr.LiteralExpr(d, TypeInfo.decimal(Math.max(p, s), s));\n    }\n\n    private Expr opExpr(Map<?, ?> m) {\n        String op = String.valueOf(m.get(\"op\")).toLowerCase();\n        switch (op) {\n            case \"-\":\n            case \"+\": {\n                // Binary if 'right' present, unary with 'arg'.\n                if (m.containsKey(\"right\")) {\n                    Expr left = compileExpr(m.get(\"left\"));\n                    Expr right = compileExpr(m.get(\"right\"));\n                    return arith(op, left, right);\n                }\n                Expr operand = compileExpr(m.get(\"arg\"));\n                requireNumeric(operand, op);\n                return new Expr.UnaryExpr(op, operand, operand.typeInfo());\n            }\n            case \"not\": {\n                Expr operand = compileExpr(m.get(\"arg\"));\n                requireBool(operand, \"NOT\");\n                return new Expr.UnaryExpr(\"not\", operand, TypeInfo.bool());\n            }\n            case \"isnull\":\n            case \"isnotnull\": {\n                Expr operand = compileExpr(m.get(\"arg\"));\n                return new Expr.UnaryExpr(op, operand, TypeInfo.bool());\n            }\n            case \"and\":\n            case \"or\": {\n                Expr left = compileExpr(m.get(\"left\"));\n                Expr right = compileExpr(m.get(\"right\"));\n                requireBool(left, op);\n                requireBool(right, op);\n                return new Expr.BinaryExpr(op, left, right, TypeInfo.bool());\n            }\n            case \"*\":\n            case \"/\": {\n                Expr left = compileExpr(m.get(\"left\"));\n                Expr right = compileExpr(m.get(\"right\"));\n                return arith(op, left, right);\n            }\n            case \"=\":\n            case \"!=\":\n            case \"<>\":\n            case \"<\":\n            case \"<=\":\n            case \">\":\n            case \">=\": {\n                Expr left = compileExpr(m.get(\"left\"));\n                Expr right = compileExpr(m.get(\"right\"));\n                requireComparable(left, right, op);\n                return new Expr.BinaryExpr(op, left, right, TypeInfo.bool());\n            }\n            default:\n                throw new QueryException(\"unknown operator: \" + op);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Expr.BinaryExpr arith(String op, Expr left, Expr right) {\n        requireNumeric(left, op);\n        requireNumeric(right, op);\n        TypeInfo lt = left.typeInfo();\n        TypeInfo rt = right.typeInfo();\n        TypeInfo result;\n        if (op.equals(\"/\")) {\n            int scale = Math.max(decScale(lt), decScale(rt)) + settings.divideExtraScale();\n            // numerator integer digits + new fraction digits, clamped to max precision\n            int precision = Math.min(settings.maxPrecision(),\n                    integerDigits(lt) + scale + 1);\n            result = TypeInfo.decimal(Math.max(precision, scale + 1), scale);\n        } else if (op.equals(\"*\")) {\n            int scale = decScale(lt) + decScale(rt);\n            int precision = decPrecision(lt) + decPrecision(rt);\n            result = TypeInfo.decimal(Math.min(settings.maxPrecision(),\n                    Math.max(precision, scale)), scale);\n        } else {\n            int scale = Math.max(decScale(lt), decScale(rt));\n            int precision = Math.max(integerDigits(lt), integerDigits(rt)) + scale + 1;\n            result = TypeInfo.decimal(Math.min(settings.maxPrecision(),\n                    Math.max(precision, scale)), scale);\n        }\n        return new Expr.BinaryExpr(op, left, right, result);\n    }\n\n    private Expr funcExpr(Map<?, ?> m) {\n        String func = String.valueOf(m.get(\"func\")).toLowerCase();\n        if (\"cast\".equals(func)) {\n            return castExpr(m);\n        }\n        if (Expr.AggregateExpr.FUNCTIONS.contains(func)) {\n            return aggregateExpr(func, m);\n        }\n        throw new QueryException(\"unknown function: \" + func);\n    }\n\n    private Expr castExpr(Map<?, ?> m) {\n        Expr operand = compileExpr(m.get(\"arg\"));\n        Object toObj = m.get(\"to\");\n        if (!(toObj instanceof String)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"CAST needs a string 'to' type, e.g. DECIMAL(10,2)\");\n        }\n        RoundingMode mode = settings.roundingMode();\n        Object modeObj = m.get(\"roundingMode\");\n        if (modeObj != null) {\n            mode = Settings.parseMode(String.valueOf(modeObj), \"cast.roundingMode\");\n        }\n        String to = ((String) toObj).trim().toUpperCase();\n        if (to.equals(\"BIGINT\")) {\n            requireNumeric(operand, \"CAST\");\n            return new Expr.CastExpr(operand, TypeInfo.bigint(), mode);\n        }\n        TypeInfo parsed = parseDecimalTypeName(to, operand);\n        return new Expr.CastExpr(operand, parsed, mode);\n    }\n\n    private TypeInfo parseDecimalTypeName(String to, Expr operand) {\n        // Accepts DECIMAL(p,s) / DECIMAL(p) / DECIMAL / NUMERIC(...)\n        String base = to;\n        int precision = settings.maxPrecision();\n        int scale = 0;\n        int open = to.indexOf('(');\n        if (open >= 0) {\n            int close = to.indexOf(')', open);\n            if (close < 0) {\n                throw new QueryException(\"malformed CAST target type: \" + to);\n            }\n            base = to.substring(0, open).trim();\n            String args = to.substring(open + 1, close).trim();\n            String[] parts = args.split(\",\");\n            try {\n                precision = Integer.parseInt(parts[0].trim());\n                if (parts.length > 1) {\n                    scale = Integer.parseInt(parts[1].trim());\n                }\n            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {\n                throw new QueryException(\"malformed CAST target type: \" + to);\n            }\n        }\n        if (!base.equals(\"DECIMAL\") && !base.equals(\"NUMERIC\")) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"CAST target type supported: BIGINT or DECIMAL(p,s), got \" + to);\n        }\n        if (precision < 1 || scale < 0 || scale > precision) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"invalid DECIMAL precision/scale in CAST: \" + to);\n        }\n        return TypeInfo.decimal(precision, scale);\n    }\n\n    private Expr.AggregateExpr aggregateExpr(String func, Map<?, ?> m) {\n        Expr arg = null;\n        if (\"countall\".equals(func) || \"count\".equals(func) && m.get(\"arg\") == null) {\n            // count(*) / countAll\n        } else {\n            Object argObj = m.get(\"arg\");\n            if (argObj == null) {\n                throw new QueryException(\"aggregate \" + func + \" requires 'arg' (use countAll for count(*))\");\n            }\n            arg = compileExpr(argObj);\n            if (!\"count\".equals(func)) {\n                requireNumeric(arg, func);\n            }\n        }\n\n        RoundingMode mode = settings.roundingMode();\n        Object modeObj = m.get(\"roundingMode\");\n        if (modeObj != null) {\n            mode = Settings.parseMode(String.valueOf(modeObj), func + \".roundingMode\");\n        }\n        Integer resultScale = null;\n        Object scaleObj = m.get(\"scale\");\n        if (scaleObj != null) {\n            resultScale = Settings.intFromJson(scaleObj, func + \".scale\");\n            if (resultScale < 0) {\n                throw new QueryException(func + \".scale must be non-negative\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        TypeInfo type;\n        switch (func) {\n            case \"count\":\n            case \"countall\":\n                type = TypeInfo.bigint();\n                break;\n            case \"sum\": {\n                TypeInfo in = arg.typeInfo();\n                if (in.type() == SqlType.BIGINT) {\n                    type = TypeInfo.bigint();\n                } else {\n                    type = TypeInfo.decimal(\n                            Math.min(settings.maxPrecision(),\n                                    Math.max(integerDigits(in) + decScale(in) + 18, decScale(in))),\n                            decScale(in));\n                }\n                break;\n            }\n            case \"avg\": {\n                TypeInfo in = asDecimalInfo(arg.typeInfo());\n                int scale = resultScale != null ? resultScale\n                        : decScale(in) + settings.divideExtraScale();\n                int precision = Math.min(settings.maxPrecision(),\n                        Math.max(integerDigits(in) + scale + 1, scale + 1));\n                type = TypeInfo.decimal(precision, scale);\n                break;\n            }\n            case \"min\":\n            case \"max\":\n                type = arg.typeInfo();\n                break;\n            default:\n                throw new QueryException(\"unknown aggregate: \" + func);\n        }\n        return new Expr.AggregateExpr(func, arg, type, nextAggregateId++, mode, resultScale);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Type helpers\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private static void requireNumeric(Expr e, String where) {\n        if (!e.typeInfo().isNumeric()) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"numeric expression required for '\" + where\n                    + \"', got \" + e.typeInfo().type());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void requireBool(Expr e, String where) {\n        if (e.typeInfo().type() != SqlType.BOOLEAN && e.typeInfo().type() != SqlType.NULL) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"boolean expression required for '\" + where\n                    + \"', got \" + e.typeInfo().type());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void requireComparable(Expr l, Expr r, String op) {\n        TypeInfo a = l.typeInfo();\n        TypeInfo b = r.typeInfo();\n        if (a.type() == SqlType.NULL || b.type() == SqlType.NULL) {\n            return;\n        }\n        boolean aNum = a.isNumeric();\n        boolean bNum = b.isNumeric();\n        if (aNum != bNum) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"cannot compare \" + a.type() + \" with \" + b.type()\n                    + \" using \" + op);\n        }\n        if (!aNum && a.type() != b.type()) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"cannot compare \" + a.type() + \" with \" + b.type()\n                    + \" using \" + op);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static int decScale(TypeInfo t) {\n        return t.type() == SqlType.DECIMAL ? t.scale() : 0;\n    }\n\n    private static int decPrecision(TypeInfo t) {\n        if (t.type() == SqlType.DECIMAL) {\n            return t.precision();\n        }\n        return 19; // BIGINT\n    }\n\n    private static int integerDigits(TypeInfo t) {\n        if (t.type() == SqlType.BIGINT) {\n            return 19;\n        }\n        return Math.max(1, t.precision() - t.scale());\n    }\n\n    private static TypeInfo asDecimalInfo(TypeInfo t) {\n        if (t.type() == SqlType.DECIMAL) {\n            return t;\n        }\n        if (t.type() == SqlType.BIGINT) {\n            return TypeInfo.decimal(19, 0);\n        }\n        return t;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_9222d90a55a3a78690177aa9","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2611,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":58168,"output_tokens":5412,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_r9817ndvuyi33ciue2hu53as":{"content":"package dpa.engine;\n\nimport dpa.decimal.Decimal;\nimport dpa.decimal.RoundingMode;\nimport dpa.error.DecimalOverflowException;\nimport dpa.error.DpaException;\nimport dpa.error.QueryException;\n\nimport java.math.BigInteger;\n\n/**\n * Mutable per-group accumulator for one aggregate expression.\n *\n * <p>All state is exact:\n * <ul>\n *   <li>{@code sum} / {@code avg} keep an exact running {@link Decimal} sum and a\n *       row count; the division producing AVG happens once at finalization with the\n *       declared scale and rounding mode — so a negative midpoint is rounded exactly\n *       once by the shared integer routine.</li>\n *   <li>BIGINT sum uses a checked {@link BigInteger} against the 64-bit range.</li>\n *   <li>{@code count}/{@code countAll} use a non-null 64-bit counter.</li>\n * </ul>\n * {@code null} arguments are skipped for sum/avg/min/max/count (SQL semantics);\n * countAll counts every row.\n */\nfinal class Accumulator {\n\n    private final Expr.AggregateExpr agg;\n    private final Settings settings;\n\n    private Decimal decimalSum;       // sum/avg of decimal args\n    private BigInteger bigintSum;     // sum of bigint args\n    private long count;               // rows contributing (count/countAll) or avg divisor\n    private Object minMax;            // min/max current value\n    private boolean sawNonNull;\n\n    Accumulator(Expr.AggregateExpr agg, Settings settings) {\n        this.agg = agg;\n        this.settings = settings;\n        this.count = 0L;\n        this.bigintSum = BigInteger.ZERO;\n        this.decimalSum = Decimal.ZERO;\n    }\n\n    void update(EvalCtx.Row row) {\n        String f = agg.function();\n        if (f.equals(\"countall\")) {\n            count++;\n            return;\n        }\n        Object v = agg.arg().eval(row);\n        if (f.equals(\"count\")) {\n            if (v != null) {\n                count++;\n            }\n            return;\n        }\n        if (v == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n        sawNonNull = true;\n        switch (f) {\n            case \"sum\":\n                addSum(v);\n                break;\n            case \"avg\":\n                addSum(v);\n                count++;\n                break;\n            case \"min\":\n                minMax = (minMax == null || compare(minMax, v) > 0) ? v : minMax;\n                break;\n            case \"max\":\n                minMax = (minMax == null || compare(minMax, v) < 0) ? v : minMax;\n                break;\n            default:\n                throw new QueryException(\"unknown aggregate: \" + f);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void addSum(Object v) {\n        if (v instanceof Long l) {\n            if (agg.typeInfo().type() == SqlType.BIGINT) {\n                bigintSum = bigintSum.add(BigInteger.valueOf(l));\n                if (bigintSum.compareTo(BigInteger.valueOf(Long.MAX_VALUE)) > 0\n                        || bigintSum.compareTo(BigInteger.valueOf(Long.MIN_VALUE)) < 0) {\n                    throw new DecimalOverflowException(\n                            \"BIGINT SUM overflow outside [-2^63, 2^63-1]\");\n                }\n            } else {\n                decimalSum = decimalSum.add(Decimal.valueOf(l), settings.maxPrecision());\n            }\n        } else if (v instanceof Decimal d) {\n            decimalSum = decimalSum.add(d, settings.maxPrecision());\n        } else {\n            throw new QueryException(\"SUM/AVG argument must be numeric, got \"\n                    + v.getClass().getSimpleName());\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Finish the aggregate.\n     *\n     * @return exact final value, or {@code null} when no row contributed\n     *         (sum/avg/min/max over an empty set; count/countAll always return 0)\n     */\n    Object finish() {\n        String f = agg.function();\n        switch (f) {\n            case \"count\":\n            case \"countall\":\n                return count;\n            case \"sum\":\n                if (!sawNonNull) {\n                    return null;\n                }\n                return agg.typeInfo().type() == SqlType.BIGINT\n                        ? (Object) bigintSum.longValueExact()\n                        : (Object) decimalSum;\n            case \"avg\":\n                if (count == 0) {\n                    return null;\n                }\n                int scale = agg.resultScale() != null\n                        ? agg.resultScale()\n                        : agg.typeInfo().scale();\n                Decimal one = Decimal.valueOf(count);\n                RoundingMode mode = agg.mode();\n                return decimalSum.divide(one, scale, mode, settings.maxPrecision());\n            case \"min\":\n            case \"max\":\n                return minMax; // null when empty group\n            default:\n                throw new QueryException(\"unknown aggregate: \" + f);\n        }\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static int compare(Object a, Object b) {\n        if (a instanceof Decimal || b instanceof Decimal\n                || a instanceof Long || b instanceof Long) {\n            Decimal da = Evaluators.decimalOf(a);\n            Decimal db = Evaluators.decimalOf(b);\n            return da.compareTo(db);\n        }\n        if (a instanceof String && b instanceof String) {\n            return ((String) a).compareTo((String) b);\n        }\n        if (a instanceof Boolean && b instanceof Boolean) {\n            return Boolean.compare((Boolean) a, (Boolean) b);\n        }\n        throw new QueryException(\"MIN/MAX cannot compare values of different kinds\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_e9e3a982a74e4397d617d376","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":5922,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":60216,"output_tokens":1730,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_mu6equwa2o86rgdo7k6dqzfp":{"content":"package == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n        sawNonNull = true;\n        switch (f) {\n            case \"sum\":\n                addSum(v);\n                break;\n            case \"avg\":\n {"parentUuid":"5cd32055-55e6-4c47-a854-76922fde5175","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_mffg78r62ytqm1hbmjrhbu3g","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp15/a/src/dpa/engine/QueryEngine.java","content":"package dpa.engine;\n\nimport dpa.decimal.Decimal;\nimport dpa.error.QueryException;\nimport dpa.json.JsonParser;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Collections;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * Single-node in-memory query engine.\n *\n * <p>Execution shape (visible verbatim in the exported plan):\n * <pre>\n *   TableScan(rows=N)\n *     └─ Filter(predicate)          [if where present]\n *          └─ Aggregate(groupKeys, aggregates=[...])   [aggregate query]\n *               └─ Project(items=[...])\n * </pre>\n * The engine is pull-based over an {@link ArrayList} of rows; there is no SQL\n * parser and no external engine — every operation below is implemented here.\n */\npublic final class QueryEngine {\n\n    /** Result of one request: fully serializable Java structures. */\n    public static final class Result {\n        public final List<Map<String, Object>> rows;\n        public final Map<String, Object> plan;\n        public final Map<String, Object> loadedData;\n        public final List<String> warnings;\n\n        Result(List<Map<String, Object>> rows, Map<String, Object> plan,\n               Map<String, Object> loadedData, List<String> warnings) {\n            this.rows = rows;\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.loadedData = loadedData;\n            this.warnings = warnings;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private final Settings settings;\n    private final Schema schema;\n    private final QueryCompiler compiler;\n    private final List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n    private final String tableName;\n\n    private List<Map<String, Object>> loadedRows;\n\n    public QueryEngine(String tableName, List<?> columnDefs, Settings settings) {\n        this.tableName = tableName;\n        this.settings = settings;\n        this.schema = Schema.fromJson(columnDefs, settings);\n        this.compiler = new QueryCompiler(schema, settings);\n    }\n\n    public Schema schema() {\n        return schema;\n    }\n\n    /** Parse and coerce a single JSON row into the engine's typed representation. */\n    public Map<String, Object> loadRow(Object rawRow) {\n        if (!(rawRow instanceof Map)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"each data row must be a JSON object\");\n        }\n        Map<?, ?> raw = (Map<?, ?>) rawRow;\n        Map<String, Object> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<String, TypeInfo> e : schema.columns().entrySet()) {\n            String col = e.getKey();\n            if (!raw.containsKey(col)) {\n                row.put(col, null);\n                continue;\n            }\n            row.put(col, schema.coerce(col, raw.get(col), settings));\n        }\n        for (Object key : raw.keySet()) {\n            if (!schema.columns().containsKey(String.valueOf(key))) {\n                warnings.add(\"input row contained unknown column '\" + key + \"' (ignored)\");\n            }\n        }\n        return row;\n    }\n\n    public void setRows(List<Map<String, Object>> rows) {\n        this.loadedRows = rows;\n    }\n\n    public Result execute(Map<?, ?> queryJson) {\n        QueryCompiler.CompiledQuery query = compiler.compile(queryJson);\n\n        // Plan is constructed before execution so it is available in explain mode.\n        Map<String, Object> plan = buildPlan(query, loadedRows.size());\n        if (query.explain()) {\n            return new Result(Collections.emptyList(), plan, exportData(), warnings);\n        }\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out;\n        if (query.aggregateQuery()) {\n            out = runAggregate(query, plan);\n        } else {\n            out = runProject(query, plan);\n        }\n        return new Result(out, plan, exportData(), warnings);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Scalar (non-aggregate) execution\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private List<Map<String, Object>> runProject(QueryCompiler.CompiledQuery query,\n                                                 Map<String, Object> plan) {\n        List<Map<String, Object>> output = new ArrayList<>();\n        long scanned = 0;\n        long filtered = 0;\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : loadedRows) {\n            scanned++;\n            EvalCtx.Row ctx = new EvalCtx.Row(settings, row);\n            if (!passesFilter(query.filter(), ctx)) {\n                filtered++;\n                continue;\n            }\n            Map<String, Object> outRow = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (QueryCompiler.ProjectionItem item : query.projection()) {\n                Object v = item.expr().eval(ctx);\n                outRow.put(item.name(), v);\n            }\n            output.add(outRow);\n        }\n        annotatePlanCounts(plan, scanned, filtered, output.size(),\n                query.aggregateQuery() ? null : 0);\n        return output;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Aggregate execution\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private List<Map<String, Object>> runAggregate(QueryCompiler.CompiledQuery query,\n                                                   Map<String, Object> plan) {\n        // Use a LinkedHashMap keyed on the grouping tuple so group order follows\n        // first appearance (deterministic without an ORDER BY).\n        Map<List<Object>, GroupState> groups = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        long scanned = 0;\n        long filtered = 0;\n\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : loadedRows) {\n            scanned++;\n            EvalCtx.Row ctx = new EvalCtx.Row(settings, row);\n            if (!passesFilter(query.filter(), ctx)) {\n                filtered++;\n                continue;\n            }\n            List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>(query.groupBy().size());\n            Map<String, Object> keyMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (String g : query.groupBy()) {\n                Object kv = row.get(g);\n                key.add(kv);\n                keyMap.put(g, kv);\n            }\n            GroupState st = groups.computeIfAbsent(key,\n                    k -> new GroupState(keyMap, query.aggregates(), settings));\n            st.update(ctx);\n        }\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> output = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (query.groupBy().isEmpty()) {\n            // Global aggregate: exactly one group, even over zero rows.\n            GroupState st = new GroupState(new LinkedHashMap<>(), query.aggregates(), settings);\n            // Re-run accumulation? No — groups map has no key for empty input.\n            // Recompute cleanly for the global case using the single state created\n            // during the scan when rows existed.\n            GroupState global = groups.isEmpty() ? st : groups.values().iterator().next();\n            output.add(finalizeGroup(global, query));\n        } else {\n            for (GroupState st : groups.values()) {\n                output.add(finalizeGroup(st, query));\n            }\n        }\n        annotatePlanCounts(plan, scanned, filtered, output.size(), groups.size());\n        return output;\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> finalizeGroup(GroupState st,\n                                              QueryCompiler.CompiledQuery query) {\n        Map<Integer, Object> finished = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Expr.AggregateExpr agg : query.aggregates()) {\n            finished.put(agg.accumulatorId(), st.accumulatorFor(agg.accumulatorId()).finish());\n        }\n        EvalCtx.Group gctx = new EvalCtx.Group(settings, st.keys(), finished);\n        Map<String, Object> outRow = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (QueryCompiler.ProjectionItem item : query.projection()) {\n            outRow.put(item.name(), item.expr().eval(gctx));\n        }\n        return outRow;\n    }\n\n    private boolean passesFilter(Expr filter, EvalCtx.Row ctx) {\n        if (filter == null) {\n            return true;\n        }\n        Object v = filter.eval(ctx);\n        return Boolean.TRUE.equals(v);\n    }\n\n    private static final class GroupState {\n        private final Map<String, Object> keys;\n        private final Map<Integer, Accumulator> accumulators = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n\n        GroupState(Map<String, Object> keys, List<Expr.AggregateExpr> aggs, Settings s) {\n            this.keys = keys;\n            for (Expr.AggregateExpr agg : aggs) {\n                accumulators.put(agg.accumulatorId(), new Accumulator(agg, s));\n            }\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> keys() {\n            return keys;\n        }\n\n        Accumulator accumulatorFor(int id) {\n            return accumulators.get(id);\n        }\n\n        void update(EvalCtx.Row row) {\n            for (Accumulator a : accumulators.values()) {\n                a.update(row);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Plan + data export\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Map<String, Object> buildPlan(QueryCompiler.CompiledQuery q, int inputRows) {\n        List<Map<String, Object>> nodes = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        Map<String, Object> scan = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        scan.put(\"node\", \"TableScan\");\n        scan.put(\"table\", tableName);\n        scan.put(\"estimatedInputRows\", inputRows);\n        scan.put(\"columns\", describeSchema());\n        nodes.add(scan);\n\n        if (q.filter() != null) {\n            Map<String, Object> filter = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            filter.put(\"node\", \"Filter\");\n            filter.put(\"predicate\", describeExpr(q.filter()));\n            nodes.add(filter);\n        }\n\n        if (q.aggregateQuery()) {\n            Map<String, Object> agg = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            agg.put(\"node\", \"Aggregate\");\n            agg.put(\"groupBy\", new ArrayList<>(q.groupBy()));\n            List<Map<String, Object>> aggDescs = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Expr.AggregateExpr a : q.aggregates()) {\n                Map<String, Object> d = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                d.put(\"id\", a.accumulatorId());\n                d.put(\"function\", a.function());\n                d.put(\"arg\", a.arg() == null ? \"*\" : describeExpr(a.arg()));\n                d.put(\"resultType\", describeType(a.typeInfo()));\n                d.put(\"roundingMode\", a.mode().name());\n                d.put(\"scale\", a.resultScale() != null ? a.resultScale() : a.typeInfo().scale());\n                aggDescs.add(d);\n            }\n            agg.put(\"aggregates\", aggDescs);\n            nodes.add(agg);\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> project = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        project.put(\"node\", \"Project\");\n        List<Map<String, Object>> items = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (QueryCompiler.ProjectionItem p : q.projection()) {\n            Map<String, Object> d = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            d.put(\"name\", p.name());\n            d.put(\"expr\", describeExpr(p.expr()));\n            d.put(\"resultType\", describeType(p.expr().typeInfo()));\n            items.add(d);\n        }\n        project.put(\"items\", items);\n        nodes.add(project);\n\n        Map<String, Object> settingsDesc = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        settingsDesc.put(\"maxPrecision\", settings.maxPrecision());\n        settingsDesc.put(\"roundingMode\", settings.roundingMode().name());\n        settingsDesc.put(\"divideExtraScale\", settings.divideExtraScale());\n\n        Map<String, Object> plan = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        plan.put(\"planVersion\", 1);\n        plan.put(\"aggregateQuery\", q.aggregateQuery());\n        plan.put(\"explain\", q.explain());\n        plan.put(\"settings\", settingsDesc);\n        plan.put(\"nodes\", nodes);\n        return plan;\n    }\n\n    private void annotatePlanCounts(Map<String, Object> plan, long scanned,\n On failure it contains {@code ok:false}, an error {@code type}\n * and message; the caller decides the process exit code.\n */\npublic final class RequestRunner {\n\n    private RequestRunner() {\n    }\n\n    public static Map<String, Object> runJson(String jsonText) {\n        Object parsed;\n        try {\n            parsed = JsonParser.parse(jsonText);\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            return error(\"JSON_PARSE_ERROR\", e.getMessage());\n        }\n        if (!(parsed instanceof Map)) {\n            return error(\"REQUEST_ERROR\", \"request root must be a JSON object\");\n        }\n        Map<?, ?> request = (Map<?, ?>) parsed;\n        try {\n            return runRequest(request);\n        } catch (DpaException e) {\n            return error(e.type(), e.getMessage());\n        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {\n            return error(\"ARITHMETIC_ERROR\", e.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> runRequest(Map<?, ?> request) {\n        Object tableObj = request.get(\"table\");\n        if (!(tableObj instanceof Map)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"request requires a 'table' object\");\n        }\n        Map<?, ?> tableJson = (Map<?, ?>) tableObj;\n\n        Settings settings = Settings.fromJson(asMap(request.get(\"settings\")));\n\n        Object nameObj = tableJson.get(\"name\");\n        String tableName = nameObj == null ? \"t\" : String.valueOf(nameObj);\n        Object columnsObj = tableJson.get(\"columns\");\n        if (!(columnsObj instanceof List)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"table.columns must be a list\");\n        }\n        QueryEngine engine = new QueryEngine(tableName, (List<?>) columnsObj, settings);\n\n        Object dataObj = request.get(\"data\");\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (dataObj != null) {\n            if (!(dataObj instanceof List)) {\n                throw new QueryException(\"'data' must be a list of row objects\");\n            }\n            for (Object r : (List<?>) dataObj) {\n                rows.add(engine.loadRow(r));\n            }\n        }\n        engine.setRows(rows);\n\n        Object queryObj = request.get(\"query\");\n        if (!(queryObj instanceof Map)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"request requires a 'query' object\");\n        }\n        QueryEngine.Result result = engine.execute((Map<?, ?>) queryObj);\n\n        Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        response.put(\"ok\", true);\n        response.put(\"rowCount\", result.rows.size());\n        response.put(\"rows\", result.rows);\n        response.put(\"plan\", result.plan);\n        response.put(\"data\", result.loadedData);\n        if (!result.warnings.isEmpty()) {\n            response.put(\"warnings\", result.warnings);\n        }\n        return response;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<?, ?> asMap(Object o) {\n        if (o == null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        if (!(o instanceof Map)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"'settings' must be a JSON object\");\n        }\n        return (Map<?, ?>) o;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> error(String type, String message) {\n        Map<String, Object> r = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        r.put(\"ok\", false);\n        r.put(\"error\", mapOf(type, message == null ? \"(no message)\" : message));\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> mapOf(String type, String message) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"type\", type);\n        m.put(\"message\", message);\n        return m;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d2832fa2219271e96a171171","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":761,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":71480,"output_tokens":2313,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_jow6fpb7qwdk8vmaksuj84iv":{"content":"package dpa.engine;\n\nimport dpa.error.DpaException;\nimport dpa.error.QueryException;\nimport dpa.json.JsonParser;\nimport dpa.json.JsonWriter;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * Top-level request runner: turns one parsed JSON request into a response map.\n *\n * <p>Request shape:\n * <pre>\n * {\n *   \"settings\": { \"maxPrecision\": 38, \"roundingMode\": \"HALF_UP\", \"divideExtraScale\": 4 },\n *   \"table\":    { \"name\": \"t\", \"columns\": [ {\"name\":\"amt\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(18,2)\", ...} ] },\n *   \"data\":     [ {\"amt\": \"-0.005\"}, ... ],\n *   \"query\":    { \"where\": ..., \"groupBy\": [...], \"select\": [...], \"explain\": false }\n * }\n * </pre>\n *\n * <p>On success the response contains {@code ok}, {@code rows}, {@code rowCount},\n * the fully materialized {@code plan}, the post-load {@code data} export and any\n * {@code warnings}. Files.readString(Path.of(requestFile), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)\n                : new String(System.in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n\n        Map<String, Object> response = RequestRunner.runJson(requestText);\n        String body = JsonWriter.write(response, pretty);\n        System.out.print(body);\n\n        if (responseOut != null) {\n            Files.writeString(Path.of(responseOut), body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        }\n        if (planOut != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(response.get(\"ok\"))) {\n            Object plan = response.get(\"plan\");\n            Files.writeString(Path.of(planOut), JsonWriter.write(plan, pretty),\n                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        }\n        if (dataOut != null && StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        }\n\n        if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(response.get(\"ok\"))) {\n            System.exit(1);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static String requireArg(String[] args, int i, String flag) {\n        if (i >= args.length) {\n            System.err.println(flag + \" requires a path argument\");\n            System.exit(2);\n        }\n        return args[i];\n    }\n\n    private static void printHelp() {\n        System.err.println(\"\"\"\n                Usage: dpa.Main [options] [request.json]\n                  (no file -> read request JSON from stdin)\n                  -o, --out PATH          write full JSON response to PATH\n                  --plan-out PATH         additionally export execution plan\n                  --data-out PATH         additionally export loaded dataset\n                  --compact               emit compact single-line JSON\n                  -h, --help              show this help\n                \"\"\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d2832fa2219271e96a171171","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":761,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":71480,"output_tokens":2313,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_dpwgppl9hpd9bc3sgssb94of":{"content":"package On failure it contains {@code ok:false}, an error {@code type}\n * and message; the caller decides the process exit code.\n */\npublic final class RequestRunner {\n\n    private RequestRunner() {\n    }\n\n    public static Map<String, Object> runJson(String jsonText) {\n        Object parsed;\n        try {\n            parsed = JsonParser.parse(jsonText);\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            return error(\"JSON_PARSE_ERROR\", e.getMessage());\n        }\n        if (!(parsed instanceof Map)) {\n            return error(\"REQUEST_ERROR\", \"request root must be a JSON object\");\n        }\n        Map<?, ?> request = (Map<?, ?>) parsed;\n        try {\n            return runRequest(request);\n        } catch (DpaException e) {\n            return error(e.type(), e.getMessage());\n        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {\n            return error(\"ARITHMETIC_ERROR\", e.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> runRequest(Map<?, ?> request) {\n        Object tableObj = request.get(\"table\");\n        if (!(tableObj instanceof Map)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"request requires a 'table' object\");\n        }\n        Map<?, ?> tableJson = (Map<?, ?>) tableObj;\n\n        Settings settings = Settings.fromJson(asMap(request.get(\"settings\")));\n\n        Object nameObj = tableJson.get(\"name\");\n        String tableName = nameObj == null ? \"t\" : String.valueOf(nameObj);\n        Object columnsObj = tableJson.get(\"columns\");\n        if (!(columnsObj instanceof List)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"table.columns must be a list\");\n        }\n        QueryEngine engine = new QueryEngine(tableName, (List<?>) columnsObj, settings);\n\n        Object dataObj = request.get(\"data\");\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (dataObj != null) {\n            if (!(dataObj instanceof List)) {\n                throw new QueryException(\"'data' must be a list of row objects\");\n            }\n            for (Object r : (List<?>) dataObj) {\n                rows.add(engine.loadRow(r));\n            }\n        }\n        engine.setRows(rows);\n\n        Object queryObj = request.get(\"query\");\n        if (!(queryObj instanceof Map)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"request requires a 'query' object\");\n        }\n        QueryEngine.Result result = engine.execute((Map<?, ?>) queryObj);\n\n        Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        response.put(\"ok\", true);\n        response.put(\"rowCount\", result.rows.size());\n        response.put(\"rows\", result.rows);\n        response.put(\"plan\", result.plan);\n        response.put(\"data\", result.loadedData);\n        if (!result.warnings.isEmpty()) {\n            response.put(\"warnings\", result.warnings);\n        }\n        return response;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<?, ?> asMap(Object o) {\n        if (o == null) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        if (!(o instanceof Map)) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"'settings' must be a JSON object\");\n        }\n        return (Map<?, ?>) o;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> error(String type, String message) {\n        Map<String, Object> r = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        r.put(\"ok\", false);\n        r.put(\"error\", mapOf(type, message == null ? \"(no message)\" : message));\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> mapOf(String type, String message) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"type\", type);\n        m.put(\"message\", message);\n        return m;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9dcae281-5e65-4ebd-b9cd-d74aa623a1e9","session_id":"9c416046-7309-42c1-be26-407fea036162","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp15/a","sessionId":"9c416046-7309-42c1-be26-407fea036162","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp15-a","slug":"purrfect-rolling-kay"}

Files.readString(Path.of(requestFile), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)\n                : new String(System.in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n\n        Map<String, Object> response = RequestRunner.runJson(requestText);\n        String body = JsonWriter.write(response, pretty);\n        System.out.print(body);\n\n        if (responseOut != null) {\n            Files.writeString(Path.of(responseOut), body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        }\n        if (planOut != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(response.get(\"ok\"))) {\n            Object plan = }\n\n    private static void printHelp() {\n        System.err.println(\"\"\"\n                Usage: dpa.Main [options] [request.json]\n                  (no file -> read request JSON from stdin)\n                  -o, --out PATH          write full JSON response to PATH\n                  --plan-out PATH         additionally export execution plan\n                  --data-out PATH }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4e110cb1-888d-4fab-b30b-fcaf493e971a","session_id":"9c416046-7309-42c1-be26-407fea036162","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp15/a","sessionId":"9c416046-7309-42c1-be26-407fea036162","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp15-a","slug":"purrfect-rolling-kay"}

public TypeInfo typeOf(String name) {\n        TypeInfo t = columns.get(name);\n        if (t == null) {\n            throw new QueryException(\"unknown column: \" + name);\n        }\n        return {"parentUuid":"2ca0e371-d144-48ea-9397-6cb5de25ee93","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_btvme3eqihovpz660d2qf6gm","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp15/a/test/dpatest/Rational.java","content":"package dpatest;\n\nimport java.math.BigInteger;\n\n/**\n * Exact rational reference value: numerator/denominator in reduced form, denominator\n * strictly positive. Used as an independent oracle in tests — {@link dpa.decimal.Decimal}\n * results are compared against true rational arithmetic, so rounding decisions\n * (especially negative midpoints) are verified against fractions, not against the\n * same integer code under test.\n */\npublic final class Rational implements Comparable<Rational> {\n\n    public static final Rational ZERO = new Rational(BigInteger.ZERO, BigInteger.ONE);\n\n    private final BigInteger num;\n    private final BigInteger den; // always > 0\n\n    public Rational(BigInteger num, BigInteger den) {\n        if (den.signum() == 0) {\n            throw new ArithmeticException(\"zero denominator\");\n        }\n        if (den.signum() < 0) {\n            num = num.negate();\n            den = den.negate();\n        }\n        BigInteger g = num.abs().gcd(den);\n        if (g.signum() != 0) {\n            num = num.divide(g);\n            den = den.divide(g);\n        }\n        this.num = num;\n        this.den = den;\n    }\n\n    public static Rational of(long n, long d) {\n        return new Rational(BigInteger.valueOf(n), BigInteger.valueOf(d));\n    }\n\n    public static Rational valueOf(long n) {\n        return new Rational(BigInteger.valueOf(n), BigInteger.ONE);\n    }\n\n    public BigInteger num() {\n        return num;\n    }\n\n    public BigInteger den() {\n        return den;\n    }\n\n    public Rational add(Rational o) {\n        return new Rational(num.multiply(o.den).add(o.num.multiply(den)),\n                den.multiply(o.den));\n    }\n\n    public Rational sub(Rational o) {\n        return new Rational(num.multiply(o.den).subtract(o.num.multiply(den)),\n                den.multiply(o.den));\n    }\n\n    public Rational mul(Rational o) {\n        return new Rational(num.multiply(o.num), den.multiply(o.den));\n    }\n\n    public Rational div(Rational o) {\n        if (o.num.signum() == 0) {\n            throw new ArithmeticException(\"division by No JUnit, no reflection\n * magic — just counters, so the whole suite stays auditable.\n */\npublic final class TestSupport {\n\n    public static final class Failure {\n        final String group;\n        final String message;\n\n        Failure(String group, String message) {\n            this.group = group;\n            this.message = message;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static int passed;\n    private static int failed;\n    private static final List<Failure> failures = new ArrayList<>();\n    private static String currentGroup = \"\";\n\n    private TestSupport() {\n    }\n\n    public static void group(String name) {\n        currentGroup = name;\n        System.out.println(\"== \" + name);\n    }\n\n    public static void check(boolean cond, String message) {\n        if (cond) {\n            passed++;\n        } else {\n            failed++;\n            failures.add(new Failure(currentGroup, message));\n            System.out.println(\"  FAIL: \" + message);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static void eq(Object actual, Object expected, String message) {\n        boolean ok = actual == null ? expected == null : actual.equals(expected);\n        if (!ok) {\n            check(false, message + \" [expected=\" + expected + \", actual=\" + actual + \"]\");\n        } else {\n            check(true, message);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static void expectThrows(Class<? extends Throwable> type, Runnable r, String message) {\n        try {\n            r.run();\n        } catch (Throwable t) {\n            if (type.isInstance(t)) {\n                check(true, message + \" (threw \" + t.getClass().getSimpleName() + \")\");\n                return;\n            }\n            check(false, message + \" [expected \" + type.getSimpleName()\n                    + \" but got \" + t.getClass().getSimpleName() + \": \" + t.getMessage() + \"]\");\n            return;\n        }\n        check(false, message + \" [expected \" + type.getSimpleName() + \" but nothing was thrown]\");\n    }\n\n    public static boolean summary() {\n        System.out.println();\n        System.out.println(\"----------------------------------------\");\n        System.out.println(\"tests passed: \" + passed + \", failed: \" + failed);\n        if (failed > 0) {\n            System.out.println(\"FAILED CASES:\");\n            for (Failure f : failures) {\n                System.out.println(\"  [\" + f.group + \"] \" + f.message);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n        System.out.println(\"ALL TESTS PASSED\");\n        return true;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"2ca0e371-d144-48ea-9397-6cb5de25ee93","session_id":"9c416046-7309-42c1-be26-407fea036162","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp15/a","sessionId":"9c416046-7309-42c1-be26-407fea036162","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp15-a","slug":"purrfect-rolling-kay"}
