{"parentUuid":"ecac5ed5-f633-4520-baf6-ceb433c19b43","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_wb7qw9b7k79ekpr3pfcpolc7","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp15/a/test/dpatest/RoundingOracle.java","content":"package dpatest;\n\nimport dpa.decimal.RoundingMode;\n\nimport java.math.BigInteger;\n\n/**\n * Independent reference implementation of fixed-point rounding, expressed directly\n * on {@link Rational} values via integer arithmetic.\n *\n * <p>This deliberately does not call {@code Decimal.roundedDivide}: it is the\n * oracle that checks it. The only shared code is the mode enum.\n */\npublic final class RoundingOracle {\n\n    private RoundingOracle() {\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Round {@code value} to {@code scale} fractional digits and return the\n     * resulting unscaled integer (value × 10^scale).\n     */\n    public static BigInteger roundToUnscaled(Rational value, int scale, RoundingMode mode) {\n        // scaled = value * 10^scale as a fraction n/d\n        BigInteger factor = BigInteger.TEN.pow(scale);\n        BigInteger n = value.num().multiply(factor);\n        BigInteger d = value.den();\n        return roundFraction(n, d, mode, scale);\n    }\n\n    /** Round n/d to an integer under {@code mode}; n and d may be signed. */\n    public static BigInteger roundFraction(BigInteger n, BigInteger d,\n                                           RoundingMode mode, int contextScale) {\n        if (d.signum() == 0) {\n            throw new ArithmeticException(\"division by zero in oracle\");\n        }\n        boolean neg = n.signum() != 0 && (n.signum() < 0 ^ d.signum() < 0);\n        BigInteger a = n.abs();\n        BigInteger b = d.abs();\n        BigInteger q = a.divide(b);\n        BigInteger r = a.subtract(q.multiply(b));\n        if (r.signum() == 0) {\n            return neg ? q.negate() : q;\n        }\n\n        // Fraction position relative to midpoint: 2r vs b.\n        BigInteger twice = r.multiply(BigInteger.TWO);\n        int cmp2 = twice.compareTo(b);\n\n        BigInteger inc;\n        switch (mode) {\n            case DOWN:\n                inc = BigInteger.ZERO;\n                break;\n            case UP:\n                inc = BigInteger.ONE;\n                break;\n            case CEILING:\n                inc = neg ? BigInteger.ZERO : BigInteger.ONE;\n                break;\n            case FLOOR:\n                inc = neg ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;\n                break;\n            case HALF_UP:\n                inc = cmp2 >= 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;\n                break;\n            case HALF_DOWN:\n                inc = cmp2 > 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;\n                break;\n            case HALF_EVEN:\n                if (cmp2 > 0) {\n                    inc = BigInteger.ONE;\n                } else if (cmp2 < 0) {\n                    inc = BigInteger.ZERO;\n                } else {\n                    inc = q.mod(BigInteger.TWO).signum() == 0\n                            ? BigInteger.ZERO : BigInteger.ONE;\n                }\n                break;\n            case UNNECESSARY:\n                throw new ArithmeticException(\"UNNECESSARY: remainder \" + r + \"/\" + b\n                        + \" at scale \" + contextScale);\n            default:\n                throw new IllegalStateException(\"mode \" + mode);\n        }\n        q = q.add(inc);\n        return neg ? q.negate() : q;\n    }\n\n    /** Render an unscaled integer at scale as a canonical decimal string. */\n    public static String render(BigInteger unscaled, int scale) {\n        if (unscaled.signum() == 0) {\n            return scale == 0 ? \"0\" : \"0.\" + \"0\".repeat(scale);\n        }\n        String sign = unscaled.signum() < 0 ? \"-\" : \"\";\n        String digits = unscaled.abs().toString();\n        if (scale == 0) {\n            return sign + digits;\n        }\n        if (digits.length() <= scale) {\n            return sign + \"0.\" + \"0\".repeat(scale - digits.length()) + digits;\n        }\n        int split = digits.length() - scale;\n        return sign + digits.substring(0, split) + \".\" + digits.substring(split);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_ac4a590e41136df14b798471","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1863,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":81720,"output_tokens":1096,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_wb7qw9b7k79ekpr3pfcpolc7":{"content":"package dpatest;\n\nimport dpa.decimal.RoundingMode;\n\nimport java.math.BigInteger;\n\n/**\n * Independent reference implementation of fixed-point rounding, expressed directly\n * on {@link Rational} values via integer arithmetic.\n *\n * <p>This deliberately does not call {@code Decimal.roundedDivide}: it is the\n * oracle that checks it. The only shared code is the mode enum.\n */\npublic final class RoundingOracle {\n\n    private RoundingOracle() {\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Round {@code value} to {@code scale} fractional digits and return the\n     * resulting unscaled integer (value × 10^scale).\n     */\n    public static BigInteger roundToUnscaled(Rational value, int scale, RoundingMode mode) {\n        // scaled = value * 10^scale as a fraction n/d\n        BigInteger factor = BigInteger.TEN.pow(scale);\n        BigInteger n = value.num().multiply(factor);\n        BigInteger d = value.den();\n        return roundFraction(n, d, mode, scale);\n    }\n\n    /** Round n/d to an integer under {@code mode}; n and d may be signed. */\n    public static BigInteger roundFraction(BigInteger n, BigInteger d,\n                                           RoundingMode mode, int contextScale) {\n        if (d.signum() == 0) {\n            throw new ArithmeticException(\"division by zero in oracle\");\n        }\n        boolean neg = n.signum() != 0 && (n.signum() < 0 ^ d.signum() < 0);\n        BigInteger a = n.abs();\n        BigInteger b = d.abs();\n        BigInteger q = a.divide(b);\n        BigInteger r = a.subtract(q.multiply(b));\n        if (r.signum() == 0) {\n            return neg ? q.negate() : q;\n        }\n\n        // Fraction position relative to midpoint: 2r vs b.\n        BigInteger twice = r.multiply(BigInteger.TWO);\n        int cmp2 = twice.compareTo(b);\n\n        BigInteger inc;\n        switch (mode) {\n            case DOWN:\n                inc = BigInteger.ZERO;\n                break;\n            case UP:\n                inc = BigInteger.ONE;\n                break;\n            case CEILING:\n                inc = neg ? BigInteger.ZERO : BigInteger.ONE;\n                break;\n            case FLOOR:\n                inc = neg ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;\n                break;\n            case HALF_UP:\n                inc = cmp2 >= 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;\n                break;\n            case HALF_DOWN:\n                inc = cmp2 > 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;\n                break;\n            case HALF_EVEN:\n                if (cmp2 > 0) {\n                    inc = BigInteger.ONE;\n                } else if (cmp2 < 0) {\n                    inc = BigInteger.ZERO;\n                } else {\n                    inc = q.mod(BigInteger.TWO).signum() == 0\n                            ? BigInteger.ZERO : BigInteger.ONE;\n                }\n                break;\n            case UNNECESSARY:\n                throw new ArithmeticException(\"UNNECESSARY: remainder \" + r + \"/\" + b\n                        + \" at scale \" + contextScale);\n            default:\n                throw new IllegalStateException(\"mode \" + mode);\n        }\n        q = q.add(inc);\n        return neg ? q.negate() : q;\n    }\n\n    /** Render an unscaled integer at scale as a canonical decimal string. */\n    public static String render(BigInteger unscaled, int scale) {\n        if (unscaled.signum() == 0) {\n            return scale == 0 ? \"0\" : \"0.\" + \"0\".repeat(scale);\n        }\n        String sign = unscaled.signum() < 0 ? \"-\" : \"\";\n        String digits = unscaled.abs().toString();\n        if (scale == 0) {\n            return sign + digits;\n        }\n        if (digits.length() <= scale) {\n            return sign + \"0.\" + \"0\".repeat(scale - digits.length()) + digits;\n        }\n        int split = digits.length() - scale;\n        return sign + digits.substring(0, split) + \".\" + digits.substring(split);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"5f4eaafc-c0ef-4ef9-9737-68e831b60b1a","session_id":"9c416046-7309-42c1-be26-407fea036162","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp15/a","sessionId":"9c416046-7309-42c1-be26-407fea036162","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp15-a","slug":"purrfect-rolling-kay"}

dpatest;\n\nimport dpa.decimal.Decimal;\nimport dpa.decimal.RoundingMode;\nimport dpa.error.DecimalOverflowException;\nimport dpa.error.DivisionByZeroException;\nimport dpa.error.RoundingException;\n\nimport java.math.BigInteger;\nimport java.util.Random;\n\nimport static dpatest.TestSupport.check;\nimport static dpatest.TestSupport.eq;\nimport static dpatest.TestSupport.expectThrows;\nimport static dpatest.TestSupport.group;\n\n/** Tests for {@link Decimal}: parsing, exact arithmetic, rounding and guards. */\npublic final class DecimalTest {\n\n    private DecimalTest() {\n    }\n\n    public static void run() {\n        parsing();\n        exactArithmetic();\n        negativeMidpointRounding();\n        scaleTransitions();\n        divisionGuards();\n        overflowGuards();\n        fuzzAgainstRationals();\n    }\n\n    private static void parsing() {\n        group(\"decimal parsing (no float path)\");\n\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"1.23\", 38).toPlainString(), \"1.23\", \"basic fraction\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"-0.0050\", 38).toPlainString(), \"-0.005\",\n                \"negative with trailing zero canonicalizes scale 4 -> 3\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"+100\", 38).toPlainString(), \"100\", \"explicit plus sign\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"0\", 38), Decimal.ZERO, \"zero canonical\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"-0.000\", 38), Decimal.ZERO, \"negative zero canonicalizes to zero\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\".5\", 38).toPlainString(), \"0.5\", \"leading-dot accepted\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"5.\", 38).toPlainString(), \"5\", \"trailing-dot accepted\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"123456789012345678901234567890.0001\", 38).toPlainString(),\n                \"123456789012345678901234567890.0001\", \"34-digit value retained exactly\");\n\n        expectThrows(NumberFormatException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"1e3\", 38), \"scientific notation rejected\");\n        expectThrows(NumberFormatException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"0.1.2\", 38), \"double dot rejected\");\n        expectThrows(NumberFormatException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"NaN\", 38), \"NaN rejected\");\n        expectThrows(NumberFormatException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"Infinity\", 38), \"Infinity rejected\");\n        expectThrows(NumberFormatException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"\", 38), \"empty rejected\");\n\n        // Canonical scale/value identity.\n        Decimal a = Decimal.parse(\"2.50\", 38);\n        Decimal b = Decimal.parse(\"2.5\", 38);\n        eq(a, b, \"2.50 canonical-equals 2.5\");\n        check(a.compareTo(b) == 0, \"2.50 compares equal to 2.5\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"-0.0050\", 38).scale(), 3, \"canonical scale of -0.0050 is 3\");\n    }\n\n    private static void exactArithmetic() {\n        group(\"exact add/sub/mul\");\n        int p = 38;\n\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"0.1\", p).add(Decimal.parse(\"0.2\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"0.3\", \"0.1+0.2 == 0.3 exactly (no float artifact)\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"-1.25\", p).add(Decimal.parse(\"0.75\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"-0.5\", \"-1.25+0.75\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"1.0005\", p).add(Decimal.parse(\"-0.0005\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"1\", \"scale align then cancel -> canonical 1\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"10\", p).sub(Decimal.parse(\"0.0001\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"9.9999\", \"10 - 0.0001 borrow\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"-3.5\", p).sub(Decimal.parse(\"-2.1\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"-1.4\", \"-3.5 - (-2.1)\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"1.25\", p).mul(Decimal.parse(\"-3\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"-3.75\", \"1.25 * -3\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"0.0001\", p).mul(Decimal.parse(\"0.0001\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"0.00000001\", \"scale adds: 4+4=8\");\n        // Large-number cancellation: 30-digit near-equal operands.\n        Decimal big1 = Decimal.parse(\"999999999999999999999999999999\", p);\n        Decimal big2 = Decimal.parse(\"999999999999999999999999999998.9999\", p);\n        eq(big1.sub(big2, p).toPlainString(), \"0.0001\",\n                \"30-digit cancellation leaves exact 0.0001\");\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * The headline acceptance check: negative midpoints under every mode, derived\n     * against the rational oracle rather than by reusing the implementation.\n     */\n    private static void negativeMidpointRounding() {\n        group(\"negative midpoint rounding (rational oracle)\");\n\n        // Exact tie cases at scale 0 (fraction exactly +/- 1/2).\n        String[][] tieCases = {\n                // value, mode, expected at scale 0\n                {\"2.5\", \"HALF_UP\", \"3\"},\n                {\"-2.5\", \"HALF_UP\", \"-3\"},     // away from zero\n                {\"2.5\", \"HALF_DOWN\", \"2\"},\n                {\"-2.5\", \"HALF_DOWN\", \"-2\"},   // toward zero\n                {\"2.5\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"2\"},     // neighbor 2 is even\n                {\"3.5\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"4\"},     // neighbor 4 is even\n                {\"-2.5\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"-2\"},\n                {\"-3.5\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"-4\"},\n                {\"-2.5\", \"UP\", \"-3\"},\n                {\"2.5\", \"UP\", \"3\"},\n                {\"-2.5\", \"DOWN\", \"-2\"},\n                {\"-2.5\", \"FLOOR\", \"-3\"},\n                {\"2.5\", \"FLOOR\", \"2\"},\n                {\"-2.5\", \"CEILING\", \"-2\"},\n                {\"2.5\", \"CEILING\", \"3\"},\n        };\n        for (String[] c : tieCases) {\n            RoundingMode mode = RoundingMode.valueOf(c[1]);\n            Decimal d = Decimal.parse(c[0], 38).setScale(0, mode);\n            eq(d.toPlainString(), c[2], \"round \" + c[0] + \" @0 \" + c[1]);\n        }\n\n        // Fractional-scale midpoints: values ending exactly 5 at one more digit.\n        String[][] fracTieCases = {\n                {\"-1.235\", \"2\", \"HALF_UP\", \"-1.24\"},\n                {\"-1.235\", \"2\", \"HALF_DOWN\", \"-1.23\"},\n                {\"-1.235\", \"2\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"-1.24\"},  // neighbor .24 even last digit 4\n                {\"-1.225\", \"2\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"-1.22\"},  // neighbor .22 even last digit 2\n                {\"1.225\", \"2\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"1.22\"},\n                {\"1.235\", \"2\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"1.24\"},\n                {\"-0.0005\", \"3\", \"HALF_UP\", \"-0.001\"},\n                {\"-0.0005\", \"3\", \"HALF_DOWN\", \"0.000\"},\n                {\"-0.0005\", \"3\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"0.000\"},\n                {\"0.0005\", \"3\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"0.000\"},\n                {\"0.0015\", \"3\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"0.002\"},\n        };\n        for (String[] c : fracTieCases) {\n            int scale = Integer.parseInt(c[1]);\n            RoundingMode mode = RoundingMode.valueOf(c[2]);\n            Decimal d = Decimal.parse(c[0], 38).setScale(scale, mode);\n            eq(d.toPlainString(), c[3], \"rescale \" + c[0] + \" @\" + scale + \" \" + c[2]);\n        }\n\n        // Explicit oracle comparison for the same cases (independent code path).\n        Rational[] tieRationals = {\n                Rational.of(-5, 2), Rational.of(-7, 2),\n                Rational.of(-247, 200), Rational.of(-245, 200),\n                Rational.of(-1, 2000), Rational.of(3, 2000),\n        };\n        RoundingMode[] modes = RoundingMode.values();\n        for (Rational r : tieRationals) {\n            for (RoundingMode m : modes) {\n                if (m == RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                for (int sc = 0; sc <= 3; sc++) {\n                    BigInteger oracle = RoundingOracle.roundToUnscaled(r, sc, m);\n                    Rational asFraction = new Rational(r.num().multiply(BigInteger.TEN.pow(sc)),\n                            r.den());\n                    if (!asFraction.isExactAtScale(0)) {\n                        Decimal parsed = parseRationalText(r);\n                        Decimal got = parsed.setScale(sc, m);\n                        eq(got.unscaled(), oracle,\n                                \"oracle check \" + r + \" @\" + sc + \" \" + m);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // UNNECESSARY: throws only when digits really must be dropped.\n        expectThrows(RoundingException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"2.5\", 38).setScale(0, RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY),\n                \"UNNECESSARY throws on non-integer\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"2.50\", 38).setScale(2, RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY).toPlainString(),\n                \"2.5\", \"UNNECESSARY allows exact rescale (2.50 at scale 2)\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"2.5\", 38).setScale(4, RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY).toPlainString(),\n                \"2.5000\", \"UNNECESSARY allows widening\");\n    }\n\n    private static void scaleTransitions() {\n        group(\"scale changes in arithmetic and division\");\n        int p = 38;\n\n        Decimal d = Decimal.parse(\"1\", p);\n        eq(d.setScale(4, RoundingMode.HALF_UP).toPlainString(), \"1.0000\",\n                \"widen integer to scale 4\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"1.23456\", p).setScale(2, RoundingMode.DOWN).toPlainString(),\n                \"1.23\", \"narrow with DOWN truncates toward zero\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"-1.23456\", p).setScale(2, RoundingMode.DOWN).toPlainString(),\n                \"-1.23\", \"negative DOWN truncates toward zero\");\n\n        // Division scale behavior.\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"1\", p).divide(Decimal.parse(\"8\", p), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP, p)\n                .toPlainString(), \"0.13\", \"1/8 at scale 2 HALF_UP = 0.13\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"1\", p).divide(Decimal.parse(\"8\", p), 4, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN, p)\n                .toPlainString(), \"0.1250\", \"1/8 exact at scale 4\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"-1\", p).divide(Decimal.parse(\"3\", p), 4, RoundingMode.HALF_UP, p)\n                .toPlainString(), \"-0.3333\", \"-1/3 at scale 4\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"2.5\", p).divide(Decimal.parse(\"-0.5\", p), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP, p)\n                .toPlainString(), \"-5.00\", \"2.5/-0.5 = -5\");\n        // divisor scale > dividend scale\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"1\", p).divide(Decimal.parse(\"0.0001\", p), 2,\n                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP, p).toPlainString(),\n                \"10000.00\", \"1 / 0.0001 = 10000\");\n        // result scale smaller than dividend scale, single rounding\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"0.55\", p).divide(Decimal.parse(\"100\", p), 1,\n                        RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN, p).toPlainString(),\n                \"0.0\", \"0.55/100 = 0.0055 -> 0.0 HALF_EVEN at scale 1\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"0.55\", p).divide(Decimal.parse(\"100\", p), 1,\n                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP, p).toPlainString(),\n                \"0.1\", \"0.55/100 = 0.0055 -> 0.1 HALF_UP at scale 1\");\n    }\n\n    private static void divisionGuards() {\n        group(\"division by zero\");\n        int p = 38;\n        expectThrows(DivisionByZeroException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"1\", p).divide(Decimal.ZERO, 2,\n                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP, p),\n                \"1 / 0 throws\");\n        expectThrows(DivisionByZeroException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"-3.5\", p).divide(Decimal.parse(\"0.00\", p), 4,\n                        RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN, p),\n                \"-3.5 / 0.00 throws\");\n        // zero / zero too\n        expectThrows(DivisionByZeroException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.ZERO.divide(Decimal.ZERO, 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP, p),\n                \"0 / 0 throws\");\n    }\n\n    private static void overflowGuards() {\n        group(\"precision overflow\");\n\n        expectThrows(DecimalOverflowException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"12345678901\", 10),\n                \"literal beyond precision rejected\");\n        expectThrows(DecimalOverflowException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"99\", 38)\n                        .mul(Decimal.parse(\"9999999999999999999999999999999999999\", 38), 38),\n                \"multiply overflowing 38 digits rejected\");\n        // 20-digit * 20-digit = 40 digits > 38\n        expectThrows(DecimalOverflowException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"12345678901234567890\", 38)\n                        .mul(Decimal.parse(\"12345678901234567890\", 38), 38),\n                \"20x20 digit product rejected at precision 38\");\n        // Addition carry overflow.\n        expectThrows(DecimalOverflowException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"99999999999999999999999999999999999999\", 38)\n                        .add(Decimal.parse(\"1\", 38), 38),\n                \"carry into 39th digit rejected\");\n        // Division whose rounded quotient is too large.\n        expectThrows(DecimalOverflowException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"1\", 38)\n                        .divide(Decimal.parse(\"1\", 38), 0, RoundingMode.HALF_UP, 5)\n                        .add(Decimal.parse(\"999999\", 38), 5) /* placeholder */,\n                \"x\"); // replaced below\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Randomized differential testing: parse random exact decimals, perform each\n     * operation with the engine, and compare against rational arithmetic. Rounding\n     * cases compare against {@link RoundingOracle}.\n     */\n    private static void fuzzAgainstRationals() {\n        group(\"fuzz: Decimal vs rational oracle\");\n        Random rnd = new Random(0xC0FFEEL);\n        int p = 60; // generous bound so fuzz failures are rounding failures, not overflow\n        int cases = 400;\n        int checkedAdd = 0;\n        int checkedMul = 0;\n        int checkedDiv = 0;\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < cases; i++) {\n            Decimal x = randomDecimal(rnd, 12);\n            Decimal y = randomDecimal(rnd, 12);\n            Rational rx = divisionGuards();\n        overflowGuards();\n        fuzzAgainstRationals();\n    }\n\n    private static void parsing() {\n        group(\"decimal parsing (no float path)\");\n\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"1.23\", 38).toPlainString(), \"1.23\", \"basic fraction\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"-0.0050\", 38).toPlainString(), \"-0.005\",\n                \"negative with trailing zero eq(Decimal.parse(\"5.\", 38).toPlainString(), \"5\", \"trailing-dot accepted\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"123456789012345678901234567890.0001\", 38).toPlainString(),\n notation rejected\");\n        expectThrows(NumberFormatException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"0.1.2\", 38), \"double dot rejected\");\n        expectThrows(NumberFormatException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"NaN\", 38), \"NaN rejected\");\n        expectThrows(NumberFormatException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"Infinity\", 38), \"Infinity rejected\");\n        expectThrows(NumberFormatException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"\", 38), \"empty rejected\");\n\n        // Canonical scale/value identity.\n        Decimal a = Decimal.parse(\"2.50\", 38);\n        Decimal b = Decimal.parse(\"2.5\", 38);\n        eq(a, b, \"2.50 canonical-equals 2.5\");\n        check(a.compareTo(b) == 0, \"2.50 compares equal to 2.5\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"-0.0050\", 38).scale(), 3, \"canonical scale of -0.0050 is 3\");\n    }\n\n    private static void exactArithmetic() {\n        group(\"exact add/sub/mul\");\n        int p = 38;\n\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"0.1\", p).add(Decimal.parse(\"0.2\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"0.3\", \"0.1+0.2 == 0.3 exactly (no float artifact)\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"-1.25\", p).add(Decimal.parse(\"0.75\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"-0.5\", \"-1.25+0.75\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"1.0005\", p).add(Decimal.parse(\"-0.0005\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"1\", \"scale align then cancel -> canonical 1\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"10\", p).sub(Decimal.parse(\"0.0001\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"9.9999\", \"10 - 0.0001 borrow\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"-3.5\", p).sub(Decimal.parse(\"-2.1\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"-1.4\", \"-3.5 - (-2.1)\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"1.25\", p).mul(Decimal.parse(\"-3\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"-3.75\", \"1.25 * -3\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"0.0001\", p).mul(Decimal.parse(\"0.0001\", p), p).toPlainString(),\n                \"0.00000001\", \"scale adds: 4+4=8\");\n        // Large-number cancellation: 30-digit near-equal operands.\n        Decimal big1 = Decimal.parse(\"999999999999999999999999999999\", p);\n        Decimal big2 = Decimal.parse(\"999999999999999999999999999998.9999\", p);\n        eq(big1.sub(big2, p).toPlainString(), \"0.0001\",\n                \"30-digit cancellation leaves exact 0.0001\");\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * The headline acceptance check: negative midpoints under every mode, derived\n     * against the rational oracle rather than by reusing the implementation.\n     */\n    private static void negativeMidpointRounding() {\n        group(\"negative midpoint rounding (rational oracle)\");\n\n        // Exact tie cases at scale 0 (fraction exactly +/- 1/2).\n        String[][] tieCases = {\n                // value, mode, expected at scale 0\n                {\"2.5\", \"HALF_UP\", \"3\"},\n                {\"-2.5\", \"HALF_UP\", \"-3\"},     // away from zero\n                {\"2.5\", \"HALF_DOWN\", \"2\"},\n                {\"-2.5\", \"HALF_DOWN\", \"-2\"},   // toward zero\n                {\"2.5\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"2\"},     // neighbor 2 is even\n                {\"3.5\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"4\"},     // neighbor 4 is even\n                {\"-2.5\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"-2\"},\n                {\"-3.5\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"-4\"},\n                {\"-2.5\", \"UP\", \"-3\"},\n                {\"2.5\", \"UP\", \"3\"},\n                {\"-2.5\", \"DOWN\", \"-2\"},\n                {\"-2.5\", \"FLOOR\", \"-3\"},\n                {\"2.5\", \"FLOOR\", \"2\"},\n                {\"-2.5\", \"CEILING\", \"-2\"},\n                {\"2.5\", \"CEILING\", \"3\"},\n        };\n        for (String[] c : tieCases) {\n            RoundingMode mode = RoundingMode.valueOf(c[1]);\n            Decimal d = Decimal.parse(c[0], 38).setScale(0, mode);\n            eq(d.toPlainString(), c[2], \"round \" + c[0] + \" @0 \" + c[1]);\n        }\n\n        // Fractional-scale midpoints: values ending exactly 5 at one more digit.\n        String[][] fracTieCases = {\n                {\"-1.235\", \"2\", \"HALF_UP\", \"-1.24\"},\n                {\"-1.235\", \"2\", \"HALF_DOWN\", \"-1.23\"},\n                {\"-1.235\", \"2\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"-1.24\"},  // neighbor .24 even last digit 4\n                {\"-1.225\", \"2\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"-1.22\"},  // neighbor .22 even last digit 2\n                {\"1.225\", \"2\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"1.22\"},\n                {\"1.235\", \"2\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"1.24\"},\n                {\"-0.0005\", \"3\", \"HALF_UP\", \"-0.001\"},\n                {\"-0.0005\", \"3\", \"HALF_DOWN\", \"0.000\"},\n                {\"-0.0005\", \"3\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"0.000\"},\n                {\"0.0005\", \"3\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"0.000\"},\n                {\"0.0015\", \"3\", \"HALF_EVEN\", \"0.002\"},\n        };\n        for (String[] c : fracTieCases) {\n            int scale = Integer.parseInt(c[1]);\n            RoundingMode mode = RoundingMode.valueOf(c[2]);\n            Decimal d = Decimal.parse(c[0], 38).setScale(scale, mode);\n            eq(d.toPlainString(), c[3], \"rescale \" + c[0] + \" @\" + scale + \" \" + c[2]);\n        }\n\n        // Explicit oracle comparison for the same cases (independent code path).\n        Rational[] tieRationals = {\n                Rational.of(-5, 2), Rational.of(-7, 2),\n                Rational.of(-247, 200), Rational.of(-245, 200),\n                Rational.of(-1, 2000), Rational.of(3, 2000),\n        };\n        RoundingMode[] modes = RoundingMode.values();\n        for (Rational r : tieRationals) {\n            for (RoundingMode m : modes) {\n                if (m == RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                for (int sc = 0; sc <= 3; sc++) {\n                    BigInteger oracle = RoundingOracle.roundToUnscaled(r, sc, m);\n                    Rational asFraction = new Rational(r.num().multiply(BigInteger.TEN.pow(sc)),\n                            r.den());\n                    if (!asFraction.isExactAtScale(0)) {\n                        Decimal parsed = parseRationalText(r);\n                        Decimal got = parsed.setScale(sc, m);\n                        eq(got.unscaled(), oracle,\n                                \"oracle check \" + r + \" @\" + sc + \" \" + m);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // UNNECESSARY: throws only when digits really must be dropped.\n        expectThrows(RoundingException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"2.5\", 38).setScale(0, RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY),\n private static void scaleTransitions() {\n        group(\"scale changes in arithmetic and division\");\n        int p = 38;\n\n        Decimal d = Decimal.parse(\"1\", p);\n        eq(d.setScale(4, exact at scale 4\");\n        eq(Decimal.parse(\"-1\", p).divide(Decimal.parse(\"3\", p), 4, RoundingMode.HALF_UP, p)\n                .toPlainString(), \"-0.3333\", \"-1/3 at scale 4\");\n expectThrows(DecimalOverflowException.class,\n                () -> Decimal.parse(\"99\", 38)\n                        .mul(Decimal.parse(\"9999999999999999999999999999999999999\", 38), 38),\n eq(got.unscaled(), expected,\n                    \"setScale \" + x + \" @\" + target + \" \" + mode);\n        }\n        check(checkedAdd > 0 && checkedMul > 0 && checkedDiv > 200,\n r, msg);\n    }\n\n    private static Rational rationalOf(Decimal d) {\n        BigInteger factor = BigInteger.TEN.pow(d.scale());\n        return new Rational(d.unscaled(), factor);\n    }\n\n    private static Decimal parseRationalText(Rational r) {\n        // Render via decimal long division-free: pick scale so fraction terminates;\n        // the fuzz values all come from decimals, but for {"parentUuid":"32f35f41-e53d-41cb-b56c-c232136d5f72","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_6cevu5wwg8ap358dclq6tq5a","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp15/a/test/dpatest/EngineTest.java","content":"package dpatest;\n\nimport dpa.engine.RequestRunner;\nimport dpa.json.JsonParser;\nimport dpa.json.JsonWriter;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport static dpatest.TestSupport.check;\nimport static dpatest.TestSupport.eq;\nimport static dpatest.TestSupport.group;\n\n/**\n * End-to-end engine tests driven through the JSON request entry point.\n *\n * <p>Covers the acceptance scenarios explicitly:\n * <ul>\n *   <li>negative midpoint rounding in grouped AVG,</li>\n *   <li>scale changes through projection/division,</li>\n *   <li>large-number cancellation inside SUM,</li>\n *   <li>empty-group results (all-NULL group and global aggregate over no rows),</li>\n *   <li>division-by-zero and overflow surfaced as typed errors,</li>\n *   <li>plan/data export presence.</li>\n * </ul>\n */\npublic final class EngineTest {\n\n    private EngineTest() {\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public static void run() {\n        groupedAvgNegativeMidpoints();\n        scaleChangeProjection();\n        largeCancellation();\n        emptyGroups();\n        globalAggregateEmptyTable();\n        divisionByZeroInData();\n        overflowInRequest();\n        filtersAndThreeValuedLogic();\n        planAndExport();\n        explainMode();\n        countAndCountAll();\n        bigintSumOverflow();\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> run(String json) {\n        return RequestRunner.runJson(json);\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static List<Map<String, Object>> rows(Map<String, Object> resp) {\n        return (List<Map<String, Object>>) resp.get(\"rows\");\n    }\n\n    private static void assertOk(Map<String, Object> resp) {\n        check(Boolean.TRUE.equals(resp.get(\"ok\")),\n                \"request ok: \" + (resp.get(\"error\")));\n    }\n\n    private static void groupedAvgNegativeMidpoints() {\n        group(\"engine: grouped AVG negative midpoint rounding\");\n\n        // [-2.5, -2.5] sums to -5.0 / 2 = -2.5 at scale 0: ties diverge by mode.\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\": {\"maxPrecision\": 38, \"divideExtraScale\": 4},\n                  \"table\": {\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"g\",\"type\":\"TEXT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":\"-2.50\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":\"-2.50\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"b\",\"v\":\"-3.50\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"b\",\"v\":\"-3.50\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"c\",\"v\":\"1.235\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"c\",\"v\":\"1.235\"}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\"groupBy\":[\"g\"],\"select\":[\n                    \"g\",\n                    {\"name\":\"a_up\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"avg\",\"arg\":\"v\",\"scale\":0,\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_UP\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"a_even\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"avg\",\"arg\":\"v\",\"scale\":0,\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_EVEN\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"a_down_tie\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"avg\",\"arg\":\"v\",\"scale\":0,\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_DOWN\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"a2_even\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"avg\",\"arg\":\"v\",\"scale\":2,\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_EVEN\"}}\n                  ]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        eq(rows.size(), 3, \"three groups\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> a = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"a\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"a_up\")), \"-3\", \"avg -2.5 HALF_UP -> -3 (away)\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"a_even\")), \"-2\", \"avg -2.5 HALF_EVEN -> -2 (even neighbor)\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"a_down_tie\")), \"-2\", \"avg -2.5 HALF_DOWN -> -2 (toward zero)\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> b = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"b\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(b.get(\"a_up\")), \"-4\", \"avg -3.5 HALF_UP -> -4\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(b.get(\"a_even\")), \"-4\", \"avg -3.5 HALF_EVEN -> -4\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> c = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"c\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(c.get(\"a2_even\")), \"1.24\",\n                \"avg 1.235 at scale 2 HALF_EVEN -> 1.24 (neighbor .24 even)\");\n    }\n\n    private static void scaleChangeProjection() {\n        group(\"engine: scale changes through division/projection\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38,\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_EVEN\",\"divideExtraScale\":6},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"id\",\"type\":\"BIGINT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(12,4)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"id\":1,\"v\":\"10.0000\"},\n                    {\"id\":2,\"v\":\"1.0000\"}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[\n                    \"id\",\n                    {\"name\":\"div3\",\"expr\":{\n                      \"op\":\"/\",\"left\":\"v\",\"right\":{\"lit\":3}}},\n                    {\"name\":\"casted\",\"expr\":{\n                      \"func\":\"cast\",\"arg\":{\"op\":\"/\",\"left\":\"v\",\"right\":{\"lit\":8}},\n                      \"to\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\",\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_UP\"}}\n                  ]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get(\"div3\")), \"3.333333\", \"10/3 at scale 6 HALF_EVEN\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(1).get(\"div3\")), \"0.333333\", \"1/3 at scale 6\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get(\"casted\")), \"1.25\", \"10/8 cast to (10,2)\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(1).get(\"casted\")), \"0.13\", \"1/8 cast to (10,2) HALF_UP\");\n    }\n\n    private static void largeCancellation() {\n        group(\"engine: large-number cancellation in SUM\");\n        // 30-digit numbers differing by 0.0001: double would collapse them.\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(34,4)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"v\":\"999999999999999999999999999999.0000\"},\n                    {\"v\":\"-999999999999999999999999999998.9999\"}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"s\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}}\n                  ]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get(\"s\")), \"0.0001\",\n                \"cancellation keeps exact 0.0001 (float would give ~1e-12 or 0)\");\n    }\n\n    private static void emptyGroups() {\n        group(\"engine: empty groups (all-NULL values)\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"g\",\"type\":\"TEXT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"g\":\"full\",\"v\":\"1.50\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"full\",\"v\":\"2.50\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"empty\",\"v\":null}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\"groupBy\":[\"g\"],\"select\":[\n                    \"g\",\n                    {\"name\":\"s\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"a\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"avg\",\"arg\":\"v\",\"scale\":2}},\n                    {\"name\":\"mn\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"min\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"mx\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"max\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"cnt\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"count\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"cnt_all\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"countAll\"}}\n                  ]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        Map<String, Object> full = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"full\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(full.get(\"s\")), \"4.00\", \"full sum\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(full.get(\"a\")), \"2.00\", \"full avg 2.00\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(full.get(\"cnt\")), \"2\", \"full count\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> empty = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"empty\");\n        check(empty.get(\"s\") == null, \"empty-group SUM is null\");\n        check(empty.get(\"a\") == null, \"empty-group AVG is null\");\n        check(empty.get(\"mn\") == null, \"empty-group MIN is null\");\n        check(empty.get(\"mx\") == null, \"empty-group MAX is null\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(empty.get(\"cnt\")), \"0\", \"empty-group COUNT(v) = 0\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(empty.get(\"cnt_all\")), \"1\", \"COUNT(*) counts the null row\");\n    }\n\n    private static void globalAggregateEmptyTable() {\n        group(\"engine: global aggregate over zero rows still yields one row\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"s\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"a\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"avg\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"cnt\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"countAll\"}}\n                  ]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        eq(rows.size(), 1, \"one global group even with zero input rows\");\n        check(rows.get(0).get(\"s\") == null, \"SUM over no rows is null\");\n        check(rows.get(0).get(\"a\") == null, \"AVG over no rows is null (no divide by zero)\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get(\"cnt\")), \"0\", \"COUNT(*) over no rows is 0\");\n    }\n\n    private static void divisionByZeroInData() {\n        group(\"engine: division by zero surfaces as typed error\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"b\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[{\"a\":\"5\",\"b\":\"0.00\"}],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[{\"name\":\"q\",\"expr\":{\"op\":\"/\",\"left\":\"a\",\"right\":\"b\"}}]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        check(Boolean.FALSE.equals(resp.get(\"ok\")), \"division by zero fails request\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> err = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"error\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(err.get(\"type\")), \"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", \"error type\");\n    }\n\n    private static void overflowInRequest() {\n        group(\"engine: decimal overflow surfaces as typed error\");\n        // Insert a value larger than column precision allows.\n        String badInsert = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(5,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[{\"v\":\"12345.67\"}],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[\"v\"]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> r1 = run(badInsert);\n        check(Boolean.FALSE.equals(r1.get(\"ok\")), \"over-wide insert fails\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> e1 = (Map<String, Object>) r1.get(\"error\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(e1.get(\"type\")), \"DECIMAL_OVERFLOW\", \"insert overflow type\");\n\n        // Arithmetic that exceeds the global bound.\n        String arith = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":6},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(20,0)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[{\"v\":\"1234567\"}],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[{\"name\":\"x\",\"expr\":{\"op\":\"*\",\"left\":\"v\",\"right\":\"v\"}}]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> r2 = run(arith);\n        check(Boolean.FALSE.equals(r2.get(\"ok\")), \"multiply beyond max precision fails\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> e2 = (Map<String, Object>) r2.get(\"error\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(e2.get(\"type\")), \"DECIMAL_OVERFLOW\", \"arithmetic overflow type\");\n    }\n\n    private static void filtersAndThreeValuedLogic() {\n        group(\"engine: filters and NULL three-valued logic\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"g\",\"type\":\"TEXT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"g\":\"x\",\"v\":\"1.00\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"x\",\"v\":\"2.00\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"y\",\"v\":null},\n                    {\"g\":\"y\",\"v\":\"5.00\"}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\n                    \"where\":{\"and\":[\n                      {\"op\":\"=\",\"left\":\"g\",\"right\":{\"lit\":\"y\"}},\n                      {\"op\":\">\",\"left\":\"v\",\"right\":{\"lit\":3}}\n                    ]},\n                    \"select\":[\"g\",\"v\"]\n                  }\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        // Note: {\"and\":[...]} shorthand isn't implemented; use explicit op form below.\n        json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"g\",\"type\":\"TEXT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"g\":\"x\",\"v\":\"1.00\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"x\",\"v\":\"2.00\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"y\",\"v\":null},\n                    {\"g\":\"y\",\"v\":\"5.00\"}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\n                    \"where\":{\"op\":\"and\",\"left\":{\"op\":\"=\",\"left\":\"g\",\"right\":{\"lit\":\"y\"}},\n                                       \"right\":{\"op\":\">\",\"left\":\"v\",\"right\":{\"lit\":3}}},\n                    \"select\":[\"g\",\"v\"]\n                  }\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        eq(rows.size(), 1, \"only the non-null y row with v>3 passes\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get(\"v\")), \"5.00\", \"correct survivor\");\n    }\n\n    private static void planAndExport() {\n        group(\"engine: plan and data export\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":28,\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_EVEN\"},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"ledger\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"g\",\"type\":\"TEXT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(12,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[{\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":\"1.00\"},{\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":\"2.00\"},{\"g\":\"b\",\"v\":\"3.00\"}],\n                  \"query\":{\n                    \"where\":{\"op\":\">\",\"left\":\"v\",\"right\":{\"lit\":0}},\n                    \"groupBy\":[\"g\"],\n                    \"select\":[\"g\",{\"name\":\"t\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}}]\n                  }\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n\n        Object planObj = resp.get(\"plan\");\n        check(planObj instanceof Map, \"plan present\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> plan = (Map<String, Object>) planObj;\n        check(Boolean.TRUE.equals(plan.get(\"aggregateQuery\")), \"plan marks aggregate query\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<Map<String, Object>> nodes = (List<Map<String, Object>>) plan.get(\"nodes\");\n        eq(nodes.size(), 4, \"scan/filter/aggregate/project nodes\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(nodes.get(0).get(\"node\")), \"TableScan\", \"first node scan\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(nodes.get(1).get(\"node\")), \"Filter\", \"second node filter\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(nodes.get(2).get(\"node\")), \"Aggregate\", \"third node aggregate\");\n\n        Object dataObj = resp.get(\"data\");\n        check(dataObj instanceof Map, \"data export present\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> data = (Map<String, Object>) dataObj;\n        eq(String.valueOf(data.get(\"table\")), \"ledger\", \"export table name\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(data.get(\"rowCount\")), \"3\", \"export row count\");\n\n        // Serialized plan must round-trip through the parser (valid JSON, exact numbers).\n        String serialized = JsonWriter.write(resp);\n        Object reparsed = JsonParser.parse(serialized);\n        check(reparsed instanceof Map, \"response round-trips through own JSON parser\");\n    }\n\n    private static void explainMode() {\n        group(\"engine: explain only\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[{\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}]},\n                  \"data\":[{\"v\":\"1.00\"}],\n                  \"query\":{\"explain\":true,\"select\":[{\"name\":\"s\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}}]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        eq(rows(resp).size(), 0, \"explain yields no rows\");\n        check(resp.get(\"plan\") instanceof Map, \"plan still returned\");\n    }\n\n    private static void countAndCountAll() {\n        group(\"engine: count vs countAll and min/max typed results\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"g\",\"type\":\"TEXT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"BIGINT\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":10},{\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":null},{\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":-3},\n                    {\"g\":\"b\",\"v\":null}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\"groupBy\":[\"g\"],\"select\":[\n                    \"g\",\n                    {\"name\":\"c\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"count\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"ca\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"countAll\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"s\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"mn\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"min\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"mx\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"max\",\"arg\":\"v\"}}\n                  ]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        Map<String, Object> a = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"a\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"c\")), \"2\", \"count skips null\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"ca\")), \"3\", \"countAll includes null\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"s\")), \"7\", \"bigint sum exact 10 + -3\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"mn\")), \"-3\", \"bigint min\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"mx\")), \"10\", \"bigint max\");\n        Map<String, Object> b = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"b\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(b.get(\"ca\")), \"1\", \"group b countAll 1\");\n        check(b.get(\"s\") == null, \"group b sum null\");\n    }\n\n    private static void bigintSumOverflow() {\n        group(\"engine: BIGINT sum overflow guard\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[{\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"BIGINT\"}]},\n                  \"data\":[{\"v\":9223372036854775807},{\"v\":1}],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[{\"name\":\"s\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}}]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        check(Boolean.FALSE.equals(resp.get(\"ok\")), \"long max + 1 overflows BIGINT sum\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> err = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"error\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(err.get(\"type\")), \"DECIMAL_OVERFLOW\", \"bigint overflow typed\");\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> byKey(List<Map<String, Object>> rows,\n                                             String key, String value) {\n        for (Map<String, Object> r : rows) {\n            if (value.equals(String.valueOf(r.get(key)))) {\n                return r;\n            }\n        }\n        throw new AssertionError(\"no row with \" + key + \"=\" + value);\n dpatest;\n\nimport dpa.engine.RequestRunner;\nimport dpa.json.JsonParser;\nimport dpa.json.JsonWriter;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport static dpatest.TestSupport.check;\nimport static dpatest.TestSupport.eq;\nimport static dpatest.TestSupport.group;\n\n/**\n * End-to-end engine tests driven through the JSON request entry point.\n *\n * <p>Covers the acceptance scenarios explicitly:\n * <ul>\n *   <li>negative midpoint rounding in grouped AVG,</li>\n *   <li>scale changes through projection/division,</li>\n *   <li>large-number cancellation inside SUM,</li>\n *   <li>empty-group results (all-NULL group and global aggregate over no rows),</li>\n *   <li>division-by-zero and overflow surfaced as typed errors,</li>\n *   <li>plan/data export presence.</li>\n * </ul>\n */\npublic final class EngineTest {\n\n    private EngineTest() {\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public static void run() {\n        groupedAvgNegativeMidpoints();\n        scaleChangeProjection();\n        largeCancellation();\n        emptyGroups();\n        globalAggregateEmptyTable();\n        divisionByZeroInData();\n        overflowInRequest();\n        filtersAndThreeValuedLogic();\n        planAndExport();\n        explainMode();\n        countAndCountAll();\n        bigintSumOverflow();\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> run(String json) {\n        return RequestRunner.runJson(json);\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static List<Map<String, Object>> rows(Map<String, Object> resp) {\n        return (List<Map<String, Object>>) resp.get(\"rows\");\n    }\n\n    private static void assertOk(Map<String, Object> resp) {\n        check(Boolean.TRUE.equals(resp.get(\"ok\")),\n                \"request ok: \" + (resp.get(\"error\")));\n    }\n\n    private static void groupedAvgNegativeMidpoints() {\n        group(\"engine: grouped AVG negative midpoint rounding\");\n\n        // [-2.5, -2.5] sums to -5.0 / 2 = -2.5 at scale 0: ties diverge by mode.\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\": {\"maxPrecision\": 38, \"divideExtraScale\": 4},\n                  \"table\": {\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"g\",\"type\":\"TEXT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":\"-2.50\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":\"-2.50\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"b\",\"v\":\"-3.50\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"b\",\"v\":\"-3.50\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"c\",\"v\":\"1.235\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"c\",\"v\":\"1.235\"}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\"groupBy\":[\"g\"],\"select\":[\n                    \"g\",\n                    {\"name\":\"a_up\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"avg\",\"arg\":\"v\",\"scale\":0,\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_UP\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"a_even\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"avg\",\"arg\":\"v\",\"scale\":0,\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_EVEN\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"a_down_tie\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"avg\",\"arg\":\"v\",\"scale\":0,\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_DOWN\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"a2_even\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"avg\",\"arg\":\"v\",\"scale\":2,\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_EVEN\"}}\n                  ]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        eq(rows.size(), 3, \"three groups\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> a = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"a\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"a_up\")), \"-3\", \"avg -2.5 HALF_UP -> -3 (away)\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"a_even\")), \"-2\", \"avg -2.5 HALF_EVEN -> -2 (even neighbor)\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"a_down_tie\")), \"-2\", \"avg -2.5 HALF_DOWN -> -2 (toward zero)\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> b = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"b\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(b.get(\"a_up\")), \"-4\", \"avg -3.5 HALF_UP -> -4\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(b.get(\"a_even\")), \"-4\", \"avg -3.5 HALF_EVEN -> -4\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> c = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"c\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(c.get(\"a2_even\")), \"1.24\",\n                \"avg 1.235 at scale 2 HALF_EVEN -> 1.24 (neighbor .24 even)\");\n    }\n\n    private static void scaleChangeProjection() {\n        group(\"engine: scale changes through division/projection\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38,\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_EVEN\",\"divideExtraScale\":6},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"id\",\"type\":\"BIGINT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(12,4)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"id\":1,\"v\":\"10.0000\"},\n                    {\"id\":2,\"v\":\"1.0000\"}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[\n                    \"id\",\n                    {\"name\":\"div3\",\"expr\":{\n                      \"op\":\"/\",\"left\":\"v\",\"right\":{\"lit\":3}}},\n                    {\"name\":\"casted\",\"expr\":{\n                      \"func\":\"cast\",\"arg\":{\"op\":\"/\",\"left\":\"v\",\"right\":{\"lit\":8}},\n                      \"to\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\",\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_UP\"}}\n                  ]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get(\"div3\")), \"3.333333\", \"10/3 at scale 6 HALF_EVEN\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(1).get(\"div3\")), \"0.333333\", \"1/3 at scale 6\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get(\"casted\")), \"1.25\", \"10/8 cast to (10,2)\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(1).get(\"casted\")), \"0.13\", \"1/8 cast to (10,2) HALF_UP\");\n    }\n\n    private static void largeCancellation() {\n        group(\"engine: large-number cancellation in SUM\");\n        // 30-digit numbers differing by 0.0001: double would collapse them.\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(34,4)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"v\":\"999999999999999999999999999999.0000\"},\n                    {\"v\":\"-999999999999999999999999999998.9999\"}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"s\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}}\n                  ]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get(\"s\")), \"0.0001\",\n                \"cancellation keeps exact 0.0001 (float would give ~1e-12 or 0)\");\n    }\n\n    private static void emptyGroups() {\n        group(\"engine: empty groups (all-NULL values)\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"g\",\"type\":\"TEXT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"g\":\"full\",\"v\":\"1.50\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"full\",\"v\":\"2.50\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"empty\",\"v\":null}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\"groupBy\":[\"g\"],\"select\":[\n                    \"g\",\n                    {\"name\":\"s\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"a\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"avg\",\"arg\":\"v\",\"scale\":2}},\n                    {\"name\":\"mn\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"min\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"mx\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"max\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"cnt\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"count\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"cnt_all\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"countAll\"}}\n                  ]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        Map<String, Object> full = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"full\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(full.get(\"s\")), \"4.00\", \"full sum\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(full.get(\"a\")), \"2.00\", \"full avg 2.00\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(full.get(\"cnt\")), \"2\", \"full count\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> empty = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"empty\");\n        check(empty.get(\"s\") == null, \"empty-group SUM is null\");\n        check(empty.get(\"a\") == null, \"empty-group AVG is null\");\n        check(empty.get(\"mn\") == null, \"empty-group MIN is null\");\n        check(empty.get(\"mx\") == null, \"empty-group MAX is null\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(empty.get(\"cnt\")), \"0\", \"empty-group COUNT(v) = 0\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(empty.get(\"cnt_all\")), \"1\", \"COUNT(*) counts the null row\");\n    }\n\n    private static void globalAggregateEmptyTable() {\n        group(\"engine: global aggregate over zero rows still yields one row\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"s\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"a\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"avg\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"cnt\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"countAll\"}}\n                  ]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        eq(rows.size(), 1, \"one global group even with zero input rows\");\n        check(rows.get(0).get(\"s\") == null, \"SUM over no rows is null\");\n        check(rows.get(0).get(\"a\") == null, \"AVG over no rows is null (no divide by zero)\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get(\"cnt\")), \"0\", \"COUNT(*) over no rows is 0\");\n    }\n\n    private static void divisionByZeroInData() {\n        group(\"engine: division by zero surfaces as typed error\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"b\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[{\"a\":\"5\",\"b\":\"0.00\"}],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[{\"name\":\"q\",\"expr\":{\"op\":\"/\",\"left\":\"a\",\"right\":\"b\"}}]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        check(Boolean.FALSE.equals(resp.get(\"ok\")), \"division by zero fails request\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> err = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"error\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(err.get(\"type\")), \"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", \"error type\");\n    }\n\n    private static void overflowInRequest() {\n        group(\"engine: decimal overflow surfaces as typed error\");\n        // Insert a value larger than column precision allows.\n        String badInsert = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(5,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[{\"v\":\"12345.67\"}],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[\"v\"]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> r1 = run(badInsert);\n        check(Boolean.FALSE.equals(r1.get(\"ok\")), \"over-wide insert fails\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> e1 = (Map<String, Object>) r1.get(\"error\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(e1.get(\"type\")), \"DECIMAL_OVERFLOW\", \"insert overflow type\");\n\n        // Arithmetic that exceeds the global bound.\n        String arith = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":6},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(20,0)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[{\"v\":\"1234567\"}],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[{\"name\":\"x\",\"expr\":{\"op\":\"*\",\"left\":\"v\",\"right\":\"v\"}}]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> r2 = run(arith);\n        check(Boolean.FALSE.equals(r2.get(\"ok\")), \"multiply beyond max precision fails\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> e2 = (Map<String, Object>) r2.get(\"error\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(e2.get(\"type\")), \"DECIMAL_OVERFLOW\", \"arithmetic overflow type\");\n    }\n\n    private static void filtersAndThreeValuedLogic() {\n        group(\"engine: filters and NULL three-valued logic\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"g\",\"type\":\"TEXT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"g\":\"x\",\"v\":\"1.00\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"x\",\"v\":\"2.00\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"y\",\"v\":null},\n                    {\"g\":\"y\",\"v\":\"5.00\"}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\n                    \"where\":{\"and\":[\n                      {\"op\":\"=\",\"left\":\"g\",\"right\":{\"lit\":\"y\"}},\n                      {\"op\":\">\",\"left\":\"v\",\"right\":{\"lit\":3}}\n                    ]},\n                    \"select\":[\"g\",\"v\"]\n                  }\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        // Note: {\"and\":[...]} shorthand isn't implemented; use explicit op form below.\n        json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"g\",\"type\":\"TEXT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"g\":\"x\",\"v\":\"1.00\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"x\",\"v\":\"2.00\"},\n                    {\"g\":\"y\",\"v\":null},\n                    {\"g\":\"y\",\"v\":\"5.00\"}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\n                    \"where\":{\"op\":\"and\",\"left\":{\"op\":\"=\",\"left\":\"g\",\"right\":{\"lit\":\"y\"}},\n                                       \"right\":{\"op\":\">\",\"left\":\"v\",\"right\":{\"lit\":3}}},\n                    \"select\":[\"g\",\"v\"]\n                  }\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        eq(rows.size(), 1, \"only the non-null y row with v>3 passes\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get(\"v\")), \"5.00\", \"correct survivor\");\n    }\n\n    private static void planAndExport() {\n        group(\"engine: plan and data export\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":28,\"roundingMode\":\"HALF_EVEN\"},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"ledger\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"g\",\"type\":\"TEXT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(12,2)\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[{\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":\"1.00\"},{\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":\"2.00\"},{\"g\":\"b\",\"v\":\"3.00\"}],\n                  \"query\":{\n                    \"where\":{\"op\":\">\",\"left\":\"v\",\"right\":{\"lit\":0}},\n                    \"groupBy\":[\"g\"],\n                    \"select\":[\"g\",{\"name\":\"t\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}}]\n                  }\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n\n        Object planObj = resp.get(\"plan\");\n        check(planObj instanceof Map, \"plan present\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> plan = (Map<String, Object>) planObj;\n        check(Boolean.TRUE.equals(plan.get(\"aggregateQuery\")), \"plan marks aggregate query\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<Map<String, Object>> nodes = (List<Map<String, Object>>) plan.get(\"nodes\");\n        eq(nodes.size(), 4, \"scan/filter/aggregate/project nodes\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(nodes.get(0).get(\"node\")), \"TableScan\", \"first node scan\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(nodes.get(1).get(\"node\")), \"Filter\", \"second node filter\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(nodes.get(2).get(\"node\")), \"Aggregate\", \"third node aggregate\");\n\n        Object dataObj = resp.get(\"data\");\n        check(dataObj instanceof Map, \"data export present\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> data = (Map<String, Object>) dataObj;\n        eq(String.valueOf(data.get(\"table\")), \"ledger\", \"export table name\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(data.get(\"rowCount\")), \"3\", \"export row count\");\n\n        // Serialized plan must round-trip through the parser (valid JSON, exact numbers).\n        String serialized = JsonWriter.write(resp);\n        Object reparsed = JsonParser.parse(serialized);\n        check(reparsed instanceof Map, \"response round-trips through own JSON parser\");\n    }\n\n    private static void explainMode() {\n        group(\"engine: explain only\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[{\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"DECIMAL(10,2)\"}]},\n                  \"data\":[{\"v\":\"1.00\"}],\n                  \"query\":{\"explain\":true,\"select\":[{\"name\":\"s\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}}]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        eq(rows(resp).size(), 0, \"explain yields no rows\");\n        check(resp.get(\"plan\") instanceof Map, \"plan still returned\");\n    }\n\n    private static void countAndCountAll() {\n        group(\"engine: count vs countAll and min/max typed results\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                    {\"name\":\"g\",\"type\":\"TEXT\"},\n                    {\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"BIGINT\"}\n                  ]},\n                  \"data\":[\n                    {\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":10},{\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":null},{\"g\":\"a\",\"v\":-3},\n                    {\"g\":\"b\",\"v\":null}\n                  ],\n                  \"query\":{\"groupBy\":[\"g\"],\"select\":[\n                    \"g\",\n                    {\"name\":\"c\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"count\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"ca\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"countAll\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"s\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"mn\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"min\",\"arg\":\"v\"}},\n                    {\"name\":\"mx\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"max\",\"arg\":\"v\"}}\n                  ]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        assertOk(resp);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = rows(resp);\n        Map<String, Object> a = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"a\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"c\")), \"2\", \"count skips null\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"ca\")), \"3\", \"countAll includes null\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"s\")), \"7\", \"bigint sum exact 10 + -3\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"mn\")), \"-3\", \"bigint min\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(a.get(\"mx\")), \"10\", \"bigint max\");\n        Map<String, Object> b = byKey(rows, \"g\", \"b\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(b.get(\"ca\")), \"1\", \"group b countAll 1\");\n        check(b.get(\"s\") == null, \"group b sum null\");\n    }\n\n    private static void bigintSumOverflow() {\n        group(\"engine: BIGINT sum overflow guard\");\n        String json = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"settings\":{\"maxPrecision\":38},\n                  \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[{\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"BIGINT\"}]},\n                  \"data\":[{\"v\":9223372036854775807},{\"v\":1}],\n                  \"query\":{\"select\":[{\"name\":\"s\",\"expr\":{\"func\":\"sum\",\"arg\":\"v\"}}]}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = run(json);\n        check(Boolean.FALSE.equals(resp.get(\"ok\")), \"long max + 1 overflows BIGINT sum\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> err = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"error\");\n        eq(String.valueOf(err.get(\"type\")), \"DECIMAL_OVERFLOW\", \"bigint overflow typed\");\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> byKey(List<Map<String, Object>> rows,\n                                             String key, String value) {\n        for (Map<String, Object> r : rows) {\n            if (value.equals(String.valueOf(r.get(key)))) {\n (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"8a652a6e-7429-4cad-bd5e-98eef3ecc60e","timestamp":"2026-09-23T03:04:11.282Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp15/a/test/dpatest/Rational.java","oldString":"        // num/den * 10^scale must be integral\n        return den.divides(num.multiply(BigInteger.TEN.pow(scale)));","newString":"        // num/den * 10^scale must be integral\n        return num.multiply(BigInteger.TEN.pow(scale)).mod(den).signum() == 0;","originalFile":"package dpatest;\n\nimport java.math.BigInteger;\n\n/**\n * Exact rational reference value: numerator/denominator in reduced form, denominator\n * strictly positive. Used as an independent oracle in tests — {@link dpa.decimal.Decimal}\n * results are compared against true rational arithmetic, so rounding decisions\n * (especially negative midpoints) are verified against fractions, not against the\n * same integer code under test.\n */\npublic final class Rational implements Comparable<Rational> {\n\n    public static final Rational ZERO = new Rational(BigInteger.ZERO, BigInteger.ONE);\n\n    private final BigInteger num;\n    private final BigInteger den; // always > 0\n\n    public Rational(BigInteger num, BigInteger den) {\n        if (den.signum() == 0) {\n            throw new ArithmeticException(\"zero denominator\");\n        }\n        if (den.signum() < 0) {\n            num = num.negate();\n            den = den.negate();\n        }\n        BigInteger g = num.abs().gcd(den);\n        if (g.signum() != 0) {\n            num = num.divide(g);\n            den = den.divide(g);\n        }\n        this.num = num;\n        this.den = den;\n    }\n\n    public static Rational of(long n, long d) {\n        return new Rational(BigInteger.valueOf(n), BigInteger.valueOf(d));\n    }\n\n    public static Rational valueOf(long n) {\n        return new Rational(BigInteger.valueOf(n), BigInteger.ONE);\n    }\n\n    public BigInteger num() {\n        return num;\n    }\n\n    public BigInteger den() {\n        return den;\n    }\n\n    public Rational add(Rational o) {\n        return new Rational(num.multiply(o.den).add(o.num.multiply(den)),\n                den.multiply(o.den));\n    }\n\n    public Rational sub(Rational o) {\n        return new Rational(num.multiply(o.den).subtract(o.num.multiply(den)),\n                den.multiply(o.den));\n    }\n\n    public Rational mul(Rational o) {\n        return new b.scale)\n        //   (note the exponent sign: scale s means *10^-s, so a/b contributes +a.scale - b.scale)\n        //   unscaled at resultScale = value * 10^resultScale\n        //                          = a.unscaled * 10^exponent / b.unscaled,\n        //   exponent = resultScale + a.scale - b.scale\n        int exponent = resultScale + this.scale - other.scale;\n        BigInteger num;\n        BigInteger den;\n        if (exponent >= 0) {\n            num = this.unscaled.multiply(BigInteger.TEN.pow(exponent));\n            den = other.unscaled;\n        } else {\n            num = this.unscaled;\n            den = other.unscaled.multiply(BigInteger.TEN.pow(-exponent));\n        }\n        BigInteger q = roundedDivide(num, den, resultScale, mode);\n        return checked(q, resultScale, maxPrecision, \"division\");\n    }\n\n    /**","numLines":35,"startLine":228,"totalLines":455}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9d143d46-2623-498d-b41a-3b74ce194232","session_id":"9c416046-7309-42c1-be26-407fea036162","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp15/a","sessionId":"9c416046-7309-42c1-be26-407fea036162","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp15-a","slug":"purrfect-rolling-kay"}
